							function showData.show(self, secondaryArgument, tertiaryArgument, durationFlag, text)
								if not text then
									text = "info"
								end

								local title = tostringFunction(secondaryArgument)
								local content = tostringFunction(tertiaryArgument)
								local duration = durationFlag or 3
								local color = colorData[text] or colorData.info
								local data = {
									title = title,
									content = content,
									duration = duration,
									color = color,
								}

								insert(self.queue, data)

								if #self.queue > self.maxQueue then
									remove(self.queue, 1)
								end

								if not self.processing then
									task.spawn(function()
										self:processQueue()
									end)
								end
							end
							function showData.processQueue(self)
								self.processing = true
								self:_ensureGui()

								while #self.queue > 0 do
									local colorResult = self.queue[1]
									local frame = self._frame

									if frame then
										pcall(function()
											frame.ColorBar.BackgroundColor3 = colorResult.color
											frame.TitleLabel.Text = colorResult.title
											frame.ContentLabel.Text = colorResult.content
											frame.Position = UDim2.new(1, 50, 1, -80)
											frame.Visible = true
											TweenService
												:Create(
													frame,
													TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
													{
														Position = UDim2.new(1, -290, 1, -80),
													}
												)
												:Play()
										end)
										task.wait(colorResult.duration)
										pcall(function()
											TweenService
												:Create(
													frame,
													TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In),
													{
														Position = UDim2.new(1, 50, 1, -80),
													}
												)
												:Play()
											task.wait(0.3)
											frame.Visible = false
										end)
									end

									remove(self.queue, 1)
									task.wait(0.1)
								end

								self.processing = false
							end

									}
									local success, result = pcall(function()
										local json = HttpService:JSONEncode(jsonencodeConfig)

										writefile(self:getSavePath(), json)
									end)
									if success then
										print("✅ Configuracion guardada en " .. self:getSavePath())
									else
										warn(
											"⚠\239\184\143 Error al guardar configuracion: "
												.. tostringFunction(result)
										)
									end
									task.delay(1, function()
										self.saveDebounce = false
									end)
								end,
								loadConfig = function(self)
									local savePath = self:getSavePath()

									if not isfile or not isfile(savePath) then
										return
									end

									local ok, result = pcall(function()
										local httpService = HttpService
										local data = { readfile(savePath) }

										return httpService:JSONDecode(unpackValues(data))
									end)
									local flag = not ok

									if not flag then
										flag = not result
									end

									if flag then
										return
									end

									self.configData = result
									print("✅ Configuración cargada - Pendiente de aplicar")
								end,
							}

								while task.wait(60) do
									if data.autoSave then
										pcall(function()
											data:saveConfig()
										end)
									end
								end
							end)
							pcall(function()
								data:loadConfig()
							end)

							local esData = {
								es = es,
								en = en,
							}

							isTabValidResult = (function()
								local ok, result = pcall(function()
									return Players.LocalPlayer.LocaleId
								end)

								if not ok or not result then
									ok, result = pcall(function()
										return LocalizationService.RobloxLocaleId
									end)
								end

								local option = ok and (not not result and result:sub(1, 2)) or "es"

								return esData[option] and option or "es"
							end)()

							function isTabValidData(flag)
								local data = esData[isTabValidResult]

								if data and data[flag] then
									return data[flag]
								end

								local es = esData.es

								return es and es[flag] or flag
							end
						end

						rayfield = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://sirius.menu/rayfield"))()

						do
							local chunk = rayfield
							local name = isTabValidData("WindowName")
							local loadingTitle = isTabValidData("LoadingTitle")
							local loadingSubtitle = isTabValidData("LoadingSub")
							local configurationSaving = {
								Enabled = true,
								FolderName = "TSB_Unified",
								FileName = "TSB_Config",
							}
							local CreateWindow = chunk.CreateWindow
							local discord = {
								Enabled = false,
							}

							createWindow = CreateWindow(chunk, {
								Name = name,
								LoadingTitle = loadingTitle,
								LoadingSubtitle = loadingSubtitle,
								ConfigurationSaving = configurationSaving,
								Discord = discord,
								KeySystem = false,
							})
						end

						enabledData = {
							enabled = false,
							getAverageFPS = function(_)
								return 60
							end,
						}
						lastTimeData = {
							ThrottleFactor = 1,
							CurrentFPS = 60,
							_frameCount = 0,
							_lastCheck = 0,
							_lastTime = 0,
							CHECK_INTERVAL = 1,
						}
						RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
							lastTimeData._frameCount = lastTimeData._frameCount + 1
						end)
						secondaryHandleInstanceProperties("PerformanceMode", function()
							local lastTime = tickFunction()

							if lastTime - lastTimeData._lastCheck < lastTimeData.CHECK_INTERVAL then
								return
							end

							local difference = lastTime - lastTimeData._lastTime

							if difference > 0 then
								lastTimeData.CurrentFPS = floor(lastTimeData._frameCount / difference)
							end

							lastTimeData._frameCount = 0
							lastTimeData._lastTime = lastTime
							lastTimeData._lastCheck = lastTime

							local CurrentFPS = lastTimeData.CurrentFPS

							if CurrentFPS < 35 then
								lastTimeData.ThrottleFactor = 4

								return
							end

							if CurrentFPS < 50 then
								lastTimeData.ThrottleFactor = 2

								return
							end

							lastTimeData.ThrottleFactor = 1
						end)

						local cfg

						do
							local textOffset = new(0, 3, 0)
							local textSize = UDim2.fromScale(6, 2)
							local ultimateOffset = new(0, 6, 0)
							local ultimateTextSize = UDim2.fromScale(8, 2.5)

							cfg = {
								DETECTION_RANGE = 30,
								RANGE_SQ = 900,
								ULTIMATE_RANGE = 30,
								ULTIMATE_RANGE_SQ = 900,
								TEXT_OFFSET = textOffset,
								TEXT_SIZE = textSize,
								ULTIMATE_OFFSET = ultimateOffset,
								ULTIMATE_TEXT_SIZE = ultimateTextSize,
							}
						end

						local markColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 255)
						local counterColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60)
						local ultimateColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 0)
						local black = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
						local counterAnimations = {
							["rbxassetid://12351854556"] = 18,
							["rbxassetid://15311685628"] = 8,
						}

						cfgData = {
							EnabledCounter = false,
							EnabledUltimate = false,
							CFG = cfg,
							MARK_COLOR = markColor,
							COUNTER_COLOR = counterColor,
							ULTIMATE_COLOR = ultimateColor,
							BLACK = black,
							COUNTER_ANIMATIONS = counterAnimations,
							playerData = {},
							markedPlayers = {},
							myRoot = nil,
							playerAddedConn = nil,
							playerRmvConn = nil,
							_registered = false,
							_hbFrame = 0,
							_liveConns = {},
							_liveChildAdded = nil,
							_inRangeSq = function(self, differenceNumber)
								if not self.myRoot then
									return false
								end

								local difference = self.myRoot.Position - differenceNumber

								return difference.X * difference.X
										+ difference.Y * difference.Y
										+ difference.Z * difference.Z
									<= self.CFG.RANGE_SQ
							end,
							_formatUltimate = function(_, secondaryArgument)
								local number = tonumberFunction(secondaryArgument)

								if not number then
									return "??"
								end

								return format("%.2f", clamp(number, 0, 100))
							end,
							_disconnectAll = function(_, data)
								for i = 1, #data do
									handlerVariantI(data[i])
								end

								table.clear(data)
							end,
							_createUltimateGui = function(self, parent)
								local BillboardGui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")

								BillboardGui.Name = "UltimateDisplayGui"
								BillboardGui.Adornee = parent
								BillboardGui.AlwaysOnTop = true
								BillboardGui.Size = self.CFG.ULTIMATE_TEXT_SIZE
								BillboardGui.StudsOffset = self.CFG.ULTIMATE_OFFSET
								BillboardGui.MaxDistance = self.CFG.ULTIMATE_RANGE + 20
								BillboardGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
								BillboardGui.LightInfluence = 0
								BillboardGui.Enabled = false
								innerData:protectGUI(BillboardGui)

								local Frame = Instance.new("Frame")

								Frame.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
								Frame.BackgroundColor3 = self.BLACK
								Frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
								Frame.BorderSizePixel = 2
								Frame.BorderColor3 = self.ULTIMATE_COLOR
								Frame.Parent = BillboardGui

								local TextLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")

								TextLabel.Name = "UltimateLabel"
								TextLabel.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
								TextLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
								TextLabel.Text = "Ultimate: ??"
								TextLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
								TextLabel.TextScaled = true
								TextLabel.TextColor3 = self.ULTIMATE_COLOR
								TextLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
								TextLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = self.BLACK
								TextLabel.ZIndex = 2
								TextLabel.Parent = Frame
								BillboardGui.Parent = parent

								return BillboardGui, TextLabel
							end,
							_createCounterGui = function(self, parent)
								local BillboardGui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")

								BillboardGui.Name = "CounterUsedGui"
								BillboardGui.Adornee = parent
								BillboardGui.AlwaysOnTop = true
								BillboardGui.Size = self.CFG.TEXT_SIZE
								BillboardGui.StudsOffset = self.CFG.TEXT_OFFSET
								BillboardGui.MaxDistance = self.CFG.DETECTION_RANGE + 10
								BillboardGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
								BillboardGui.LightInfluence = 0
								innerData:protectGUI(BillboardGui)

								local Frame = Instance.new("Frame")

								Frame.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
								Frame.BackgroundColor3 = self.BLACK
								Frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
								Frame.BorderSizePixel = 2
								Frame.BorderColor3 = self.MARK_COLOR
								Frame.Parent = BillboardGui

								local TextLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")

								TextLabel.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
								TextLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
								TextLabel.Text = "COUNTER USADO"
								TextLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
								TextLabel.TextScaled = true
								TextLabel.TextColor3 = self.MARK_COLOR
								TextLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
								TextLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = self.BLACK
								TextLabel.ZIndex = 2
								TextLabel.Parent = Frame
								BillboardGui.Parent = parent

								return BillboardGui
							end,
							_markPlayer = function(self, secondaryArgument, parent, quaternaryArgument)
								if self.markedPlayers[secondaryArgument] then
									return
								end

								local HumanoidRootPart = parent:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

								if not HumanoidRootPart then
									return
								end

								local Highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")

								Highlight.FillColor = self.MARK_COLOR
								Highlight.OutlineColor = self.MARK_COLOR
								Highlight.FillTransparency = 0.4
								Highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
								Highlight.Parent = parent

								local counterGui = self:_createCounterGui(HumanoidRootPart)

								self.markedPlayers[secondaryArgument] = {
									highlight = Highlight,
									gui = counterGui,
								}
								task.delay(quaternaryArgument, function()
									local flag = self.markedPlayers[secondaryArgument]

									if not flag then
										return
									end

									pcall(function()
										if flag.highlight and flag.highlight.Parent then
											flag.highlight:Destroy()
										end

										if flag.gui and flag.gui.Parent then
											flag.gui:Destroy()
										end
									end)
									self.markedPlayers[secondaryArgument] = nil
								end)
							end,
							_findUltimateObj = function(_, player)
								local callbackData = {
									"Ultimate",
									"ultimate",
								}
								local data = {
									NumberValue = true,
									IntValue = true,
									StringValue = true,
								}
								local flagCallback, flagResult, flag = ipairsFunction(callbackData)
								local firstChild

								repeat
									local firstChildResult

									flag, firstChildResult = flagCallback(flagResult, flag)

									if not flag then
										if player.Character then
											for _, item in ipairsFunction(callbackData) do
												local firstChild = player.Character:FindFirstChild(item)

												if firstChild and firstChild:IsA("NumberValue") then
													return firstChild
												end
											end
										end

										return nil
									end

									firstChild = player:FindFirstChild(firstChildResult)
								until firstChild and data[firstChild.ClassName]

								return firstChild
							end,
							_hookUltimateValue = function(self, secondaryArgument)
								local ultimateObjFlag = self.playerData[secondaryArgument]

								if not ultimateObjFlag then
									return
								end

								local ultimateObj = self:_findUltimateObj(secondaryArgument)

								if not ultimateObj or ultimateObj == ultimateObjFlag.ultimateObj then
									return
								end

								ultimateObjFlag.ultimateObj = ultimateObj

								local connection = ultimateObj.Changed:Connect(function(property)
									if ultimateObjFlag.ultimateLabel and ultimateObjFlag.ultimateLabel.Parent then
										ultimateObjFlag.ultimateLabel.Text = "Ultimate: "
											.. self:_formatUltimate(property)
									end
								end)

								insert(ultimateObjFlag.playerConns, connection)

								if ultimateObjFlag.ultimateLabel and ultimateObjFlag.ultimateLabel.Parent then
									ultimateObjFlag.ultimateLabel.Text = "Ultimate: "
										.. self:_formatUltimate(ultimateObj.Value)
								end
							end,
							_watchCharacter = function(self, secondaryArgument, humanoidContainer)
								local rootFlag = self.playerData[secondaryArgument]

								if not rootFlag then
									return
								end

								self:_disconnectAll(rootFlag.charConns)

								local Humanoid = humanoidContainer:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
								local HumanoidRootPart = humanoidContainer:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)

								if not Humanoid or not HumanoidRootPart then
									return
								end

								local Animator = Humanoid:WaitForChild("Animator", 5)

								if not Animator then
									return
								end

								rootFlag.root = HumanoidRootPart

								if rootFlag.ultimateGui and rootFlag.ultimateGui.Parent then
									rootFlag.ultimateGui:Destroy()
								end

								local ultimateGui, ultimateLabel = self:_createUltimateGui(HumanoidRootPart)

								rootFlag.ultimateGui = ultimateGui
								rootFlag.ultimateLabel = ultimateLabel

								if rootFlag.ultimateObj and rootFlag.ultimateObj.Parent then
									ultimateLabel.Text = "Ultimate: "
										.. self:_formatUltimate(rootFlag.ultimateObj.Value)
								elseif secondaryArgument:GetAttribute("Ultimate") ~= nil then
									ultimateLabel.Text = "Ultimate: "
										.. self:_formatUltimate(secondaryArgument:GetAttribute("Ultimate"))
								end

								local connection = Animator.AnimationPlayed:Connect(function(animation)
									if not self.EnabledCounter then
										return
									end

									local Animation = animation.Animation

									if not Animation then
										return
									end

									local animationId = self.COUNTER_ANIMATIONS[Animation.AnimationId]

									if not animationId then
										return
									end

									if not self:_inRangeSq(HumanoidRootPart.Position) then
										return
									end

									self:_markPlayer(secondaryArgument, humanoidContainer, animationId)
								end)

								insert(rootFlag.charConns, connection)
								self:_hookUltimateValue(secondaryArgument)
							end,
							_cleanupPlayer = function(self, secondaryArgument)
								local condition = self.playerData[secondaryArgument]

								if condition then
									self:_disconnectAll(condition.playerConns)
									self:_disconnectAll(condition.charConns)

									if condition.ultimateGui and condition.ultimateGui.Parent then
										condition.ultimateGui:Destroy()
									end

									self.playerData[secondaryArgument] = nil
								end

								local guiCondition = self.markedPlayers[secondaryArgument]

								if guiCondition then
									pcall(function()
										if guiCondition.highlight and guiCondition.highlight.Parent then
											guiCondition.highlight:Destroy()
										end

										if guiCondition.gui and guiCondition.gui.Parent then
											guiCondition.gui:Destroy()
										end
									end)
									self.markedPlayers[secondaryArgument] = nil
								end
							end,
							_setupPlayer = function(self, player)
								if player == LocalPlayer then
									return
								end

								self.playerData[player] = {
									root = nil,
									ultimateGui = nil,
									ultimateLabel = nil,
									ultimateObj = nil,
									playerConns = {},
									charConns = {},
								}

								local playerConnsResult = self.playerData[player]
								local connection = player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Ultimate"):Connect(function()
									if
										playerConnsResult.ultimateLabel
										and (
											playerConnsResult.ultimateLabel.Parent and not playerConnsResult.ultimateObj
										)
									then
										local Ultimate = player:GetAttribute("Ultimate")

										playerConnsResult.ultimateLabel.Text = "Ultimate: "
											.. self:_formatUltimate(Ultimate)
									end
								end)

								insert(playerConnsResult.playerConns, connection)

								local secondaryConnection = player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
									task.delay(1, function()
										if self.playerData[player] then
											self:_watchCharacter(player, character)
										end
									end)
								end)

								insert(playerConnsResult.playerConns, secondaryConnection)

								local alternateConnection = player.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
									if not player:IsDescendantOf(game) then
										self:_cleanupPlayer(player)
									end
								end)

								insert(playerConnsResult.playerConns, alternateConnection)

								if player.Character then
									task.delay(1, function()
										if self.playerData[player] then
											self:_watchCharacter(player, player.Character)
										end
									end)
								end

								self:_hookUltimateValue(player)
							end,
							_startHeartbeat = function(self)
								if self._registered then
									return
								end

								self._registered = true
								self._hbFrame = 0
								secondaryHandleInstanceProperties("ESPCounter", function()
									self._hbFrame = self._hbFrame + 1
									if self._hbFrame < 5 * lastTimeData.ThrottleFactor then
										return
									end
									self._hbFrame = 0
									if not self.myRoot then
										return
									end
									local myRootPosition = self.myRoot.Position
									local next = nextFunction
									local playerData = self.playerData
									local flag
									while true do
										local flagResult

										flag, flagResult = next(playerData, flag)

										if not flag then
											break
										end

										local ultimateGui = flagResult.ultimateGui
										local root = flagResult.root

										if ultimateGui and (root and root.Parent) then
											local difference = myRootPosition - root.Position
											local isCfgUltimateRangeSq = difference.X * difference.X
													+ difference.Y * difference.Y
													+ difference.Z * difference.Z
												<= self.CFG.ULTIMATE_RANGE_SQ
											local enabled = self.EnabledUltimate and isCfgUltimateRangeSq

											if enabled ~= ultimateGui.Enabled then
												ultimateGui.Enabled = enabled
											end
										end
									end
								end)
							end,
							_stopHeartbeat = function(self)
								self._registered = false
								handler("ESPCounter")
							end,
							_watchLocalPlayer = function(self)
								LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
									self.myRoot = nil
									self.myRoot = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
								end)
								LocalPlayer.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function()
									self.myRoot = nil
								end)

								if LocalPlayer.Character then
									self.myRoot = LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
								end
							end,
							_monitorLiveModel = function(self, counterContainer)
								local condition = self._liveConns[counterContainer]

								if condition then
									for _, item in ipairsFunction(condition) do
										handlerVariantI(item)
									end
								end

								local data = {}

								self._liveConns[counterContainer] = data

								local adornee = counterContainer:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
									or counterContainer:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")

								local function createLiveCounterGui()
									if not adornee or not adornee.Parent then
										return
									end

									local LiveCounterGui = adornee:FindFirstChild("LiveCounterGui")

									if not LiveCounterGui then
										LiveCounterGui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
										LiveCounterGui.Name = "LiveCounterGui"
										LiveCounterGui.Adornee = adornee
										LiveCounterGui.AlwaysOnTop = true
										LiveCounterGui.Size = self.CFG.TEXT_SIZE
										LiveCounterGui.StudsOffset = self.CFG.TEXT_OFFSET
										LiveCounterGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
										LiveCounterGui.LightInfluence = 0
										innerData:protectGUI(LiveCounterGui)

										local Frame = Instance.new("Frame")

										Frame.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
										Frame.BackgroundColor3 = self.BLACK
										Frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
										Frame.BorderSizePixel = 2
										Frame.BorderColor3 = self.COUNTER_COLOR
										Frame.Parent = LiveCounterGui

										local TextLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")

										TextLabel.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
										TextLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
										TextLabel.Text = "COUNTER"
										TextLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
										TextLabel.TextScaled = true
										TextLabel.TextColor3 = self.COUNTER_COLOR
										TextLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
										TextLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = self.BLACK
										TextLabel.ZIndex = 2
										TextLabel.Parent = Frame
										LiveCounterGui.Parent = adornee
									end

									local LiveCounterHL = counterContainer:FindFirstChild("LiveCounterHL")

									if not LiveCounterHL then
										local Highlight = counterContainer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Highlight")

										if Highlight then
											pcall(function()
												Highlight:Destroy()
											end)
										end

										LiveCounterHL = Instance.new("Highlight")
										LiveCounterHL.Name = "LiveCounterHL"
										LiveCounterHL.FillColor = self.COUNTER_COLOR
										LiveCounterHL.OutlineColor = self.COUNTER_COLOR
										LiveCounterHL.FillTransparency = 0.4
										LiveCounterHL.OutlineTransparency = 0
										LiveCounterHL.Parent = counterContainer
									end

									local capturedLiveCounterGui = LiveCounterGui
									local capturedLiveCounterHl = LiveCounterHL

									task.delay(10.3, function()
										pcall(function()
											if capturedLiveCounterGui and capturedLiveCounterGui.Parent then
												capturedLiveCounterGui:Destroy()
											end
										end)
										pcall(function()
											if capturedLiveCounterHl and capturedLiveCounterHl.Parent then
												capturedLiveCounterHl:Destroy()
											end
										end)
									end)
								end

								if counterContainer:FindFirstChild("Counter") then
									createLiveCounterGui()
								end

								insert(
									data,
									counterContainer.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
										if child.Name == "Counter" then
											createLiveCounterGui()
										end
									end)
								)
								insert(
									data,
									counterContainer.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
										if not parent then
											pcall(function()
												if adornee and adornee.Parent then
													local LiveCounterGui = adornee:FindFirstChild("LiveCounterGui")

													if LiveCounterGui then
														LiveCounterGui:Destroy()
													end
												end
											end)
											pcall(function()
												local LiveCounterHL = counterContainer:FindFirstChild("LiveCounterHL")

												if LiveCounterHL then
													LiveCounterHL:Destroy()
												end
											end)

											local condition = self._liveConns[counterContainer]

											if condition then
												for _, item in ipairsFunction(condition) do
													handlerVariantI(item)
												end
											end

											self._liveConns[counterContainer] = nil
										end
									end)
								)
							end,
							_startLiveMonitor = function(self)
								local Live = Workspace:WaitForChild("Live", 10)

								if not Live then
									return
								end

								for _, item in ipairsFunction(Live:GetChildren()) do
									self:_monitorLiveModel(item)
								end

								self._liveChildAdded = Live.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
									self:_monitorLiveModel(child)
								end)
							end,
							_stopLiveMonitor = function(self)
								handlerVariantI(self._liveChildAdded)
								self._liveChildAdded = nil
								local next = nextFunction
								local liveConns = self._liveConns
								local liveCounterHlContainer
								while true do
									local liveCounterHlContainerFlagResult

									liveCounterHlContainer, liveCounterHlContainerFlagResult =
										next(liveConns, liveCounterHlContainer)

									if not liveCounterHlContainer then
										break
									end

									local humanoidRootPartContainer = liveCounterHlContainer

									for _, item in ipairsFunction(liveCounterHlContainerFlagResult) do
										handlerVariantI(item)
									end

									pcall(function()
										local liveCounterGuiContainer = humanoidRootPartContainer:FindFirstChild(
											"HumanoidRootPart"
										) or humanoidRootPartContainer:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")

										if liveCounterGuiContainer then
											local LiveCounterGui =
												liveCounterGuiContainer:FindFirstChild("LiveCounterGui")

											if LiveCounterGui then
												LiveCounterGui:Destroy()
											end
										end

										local LiveCounterHL = humanoidRootPartContainer:FindFirstChild("LiveCounterHL")

										if LiveCounterHL then
											LiveCounterHL:Destroy()
										end
									end)
								end
								self._liveConns = {}
							end,
							start = function(self)
								if self.playerAddedConn then
									return
								end

								self:_watchLocalPlayer()
								self:_startHeartbeat()

								for _, item in ipairsFunction(Players:GetPlayers()) do
									if item ~= LocalPlayer then
										self:_setupPlayer(item)
									end
								end

								self.playerAddedConn = Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
									self:_setupPlayer(player)
								end)
								self.playerRmvConn = Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
									self:_cleanupPlayer(player)
								end)

								if self.EnabledCounter then
									task.spawn(function()
										self:_startLiveMonitor()
									end)
								end
							end,
							stop = function(self)
								if self.EnabledCounter or self.EnabledUltimate then
									if not self.EnabledUltimate then
										local next = nextFunction
										local playerData = self.playerData
										local flag
										while true do
											local flagResult

											flag, flagResult = next(playerData, flag)

											if not flag then
												break
											end

											if flagResult.ultimateGui then
												flagResult.ultimateGui.Enabled = false
											end
										end
									end

									return
								end
								handlerVariantI(self.playerAddedConn)
								self.playerAddedConn = nil
								handlerVariantI(self.playerRmvConn)
								self.playerRmvConn = nil
								self:_stopHeartbeat()
								self:_stopLiveMonitor()
								local data = {}
								local next = nextFunction
								local playerData = self.playerData
								local flag
								while true do
									flag = next(playerData, flag)

									if not flag then
										break
									end

									data[#data + 1] = flag
								end
								for _, item in ipairsFunction(data) do
									self:_cleanupPlayer(item)
								end
							end,
						}
					end

					local config = {
						AimbotSpeed = 5,
						PredictionEnabled = false,
						CameraEnabled = false,
						CameraRange = 5,
					}

					enemyData = {
						State = false,
						Enemy = nil,
						Config = config,
						Highlight = nil,
						lastVelocity = {},
						initialize = function(self)
							self.Highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
							self.Highlight.FillTransparency = 0.55
							self.Highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
							self.Highlight.Enabled = false
							self.Highlight.Parent = CoreGui
							self.Highlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 0)
							self.Highlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 0)
							innerData:protectGUI(self.Highlight)
						end,
					}
					number = 0.04

					function enemyData.getPing(_)
						if tickFunction() - 0 < 0.5 then
							return number
						end

						local dataPing = Stats.Network.ServerStatsItem:FindFirstChild("Data Ping")

						number = dataPing and dataPing:GetValue() / 1000 or 0.04

						return number
					end
					function enemyData.getDynamicPrediction(self, input)
						if not input or not LocalPlayer.Character then
							return 0.11
						end

						local HumanoidRootPart = LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

						if not HumanoidRootPart then
							return 0.11
						end

						local Magnitude = (HumanoidRootPart.Position - input.Position).Magnitude
						local AssemblyLinearVelocity = input.AssemblyLinearVelocity
						local magnitude = AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude
						local secondaryMagnitude = (AssemblyLinearVelocity - self.lastVelocity[input] or Vector3.zero).Magnitude

						self.lastVelocity[input] = AssemblyLinearVelocity

						local Unit = (HumanoidRootPart.Position - input.Position).Unit
						local unit = magnitude > 0

						if unit then
							unit = AssemblyLinearVelocity.Unit
						end

						local clampedValueOption = unit or Vector3.zero
						local clampedValue = clamp(clampedValueOption:Dot(Unit), -1, 1)
						local ping = self:getPing()
						local quotient = Magnitude / 950
						local number = secondaryMagnitude / 450
						local product = clampedValue * 0.045
						local sum = 0.09 + magnitude / 280 + quotient + number - product + ping

						return clamp(sum, 0.07, 0.28)
					end

					local closestData = {}

					function enemyData.findNearestEnemy(_)
						if tickFunction() - 0 < 0.1 then
							return closestData.closest
						end
						local magnitude = distNumber
						local secondaryClosest
						local ViewportSize = CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
						local magnitudeNumber = secondaryNew(ViewportSize.X / 2, ViewportSize.Y / 2)
						local players = Players:GetPlayers()
						for i = 1, #players do
							local secondaryI = players[i]

							if secondaryI ~= LocalPlayer then
								local Character = secondaryI.Character
								local closest = Character and Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
								local option = Character and Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")

								if closest and (option and option.Health > 0) then
									local vector, condition = CurrentCamera:WorldToViewportPoint(closest.Position)

									if condition then
										local Magnitude = (magnitudeNumber - secondaryNew(vector.X, vector.Y)).Magnitude

										if Magnitude < magnitude then
											secondaryClosest = closest
											magnitude = Magnitude
										end
									end
								end
							end
						end
						local Live = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Live")
						if Live then
							local children = Live:GetChildren()

							for i = 1, #children do
								local humanoidContainer = children[i]

								if humanoidContainer:IsA("Model") and humanoidContainer ~= LocalPlayer.Character then
									local HumanoidRootPart = humanoidContainer:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
									local humanoidRootPart = HumanoidRootPart
									local Humanoid = humanoidContainer:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")

									if HumanoidRootPart then
										humanoidRootPart = Humanoid and Humanoid.Health > 0
									end

									if humanoidRootPart then
										local vector, condition =
											CurrentCamera:WorldToViewportPoint(HumanoidRootPart.Position)

										if condition then
											local Magnitude = (magnitudeNumber - secondaryNew(vector.X, vector.Y)).Magnitude

											if Magnitude < magnitude then
												magnitude = Magnitude
												secondaryClosest = HumanoidRootPart
											end
										end
									end
								end
							end
						end
						closestData.closest = secondaryClosest

						return secondaryClosest
					end
					function enemyData.toggle(self)
						self.State = not self.State

						if self.State then
							self.Enemy = self:findNearestEnemy()

							if self.Enemy and self.Enemy.Parent then
								self.Highlight.Adornee = self.Enemy.Parent
								self.Highlight.Enabled = true

								return
							end

							self.State = false

							return
						end

						self.Highlight.Enabled = false
						self.Enemy = nil
					end
					function enemyData.update(self)
						if not self.State or not self.Enemy then
							return
						end

						local Character = LocalPlayer.Character

						if not Character then
							return
						end

						local HumanoidRootPart = Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

						if not HumanoidRootPart then
							return
						end

						local option = self.Enemy.Parent and self.Enemy.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

						if not self.Enemy.Parent or option and option.Health <= 0 then
							self.Enemy = self:findNearestEnemy()

							if not self.Enemy then
								self.State = false
								self.Highlight.Enabled = false

								return
							end

							self.Highlight.Adornee = self.Enemy.Parent
							self.Highlight.Enabled = true
						end

						if not HumanoidRootPart or not self.Enemy.Parent then
							return
						end

						local EnemyPosition = self.Enemy.Position
						local HumanoidRootPartPosition = HumanoidRootPart.Position
						local difference = HumanoidRootPartPosition.X - EnemyPosition.X
						local number = HumanoidRootPartPosition.Z - EnemyPosition.Z
						local sum = difference * difference + number * number
						local CameraRange = self.Config.CameraRange
						local flag = sum <= CameraRange * CameraRange

						if self.Config.CameraEnabled and flag then
							return
						end

						if self.Config.PredictionEnabled then
							local dynamicPrediction = self:getDynamicPrediction(self.Enemy)
							local AssemblyLinearVelocity = self.Enemy.AssemblyLinearVelocity
							local AssemblyLinearVelocityX = AssemblyLinearVelocity.X
							local AssemblyLinearVelocityZ = AssemblyLinearVelocity.Z
							local product = AssemblyLinearVelocityZ * AssemblyLinearVelocityZ
							local quotientNumber = sqrt(AssemblyLinearVelocityX * AssemblyLinearVelocityX + product)
							local clampedValue = 0

							if quotientNumber > 2 then
								local quotient = 1 / quotientNumber
								local product = AssemblyLinearVelocityZ * quotient
								local secondaryProduct = AssemblyLinearVelocityX * quotient
								local secondaryQuotientNumber = sqrt(sum)

								if secondaryQuotientNumber > 0.1 then
									local quotient = 1 / secondaryQuotientNumber
									local alternateProduct = -number * quotient
									local additionalProduct = -difference * quotient

									clampedValue =
										clamp(secondaryProduct * additionalProduct + product * alternateProduct, 0, 1)
								end
							end

							local secondaryProduct = clampedValue * 1.6

							EnemyPosition += AssemblyLinearVelocity * (dynamicPrediction * clamp(
								1 - secondaryProduct,
								0,
								1
							))
						end

						CurrentCamera.CFrame = CurrentCamera.CFrame:Lerp(
							cFrameCallback(CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position, EnemyPosition),
							self.Config.AimbotSpeed / 10
						)
					end

					secondaryHandleInstanceProperties("Camlock", function(_)
						enemyData:update()
					end)

					local sideDashAnims = {
						["rbxassetid://10480793962"] = true,
						["rbxassetid://10480796021"] = true,
					}

					updateInstancePropertiesData = {
						Enabled = false,
						Separation = 8,
						frontGui = nil,
						frontBar = nil,
						frontGrad = nil,
						sideGui = nil,
						sideBar = nil,
						sideGrad = nil,
						frontTime = 0,
						sideTime = 0,
						_frontProg = 0,
						_sideProg = 0,
						frontPulseActive = false,
						sidePulseActive = false,
						_gradFrame = 0,
						SIDE_DASH_ANIMS = sideDashAnims,
						SIDE_COOLDOWN = 1.9,
						FRONT_DASH_ANIM = "rbxassetid://10479335397",
						FRONT_COOLDOWN = 5.3,
						createCooldownGui = function(_, backgroundColor3, textLabel, studsOffset)
							local BillboardGui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")

							BillboardGui.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(140, 26)
							BillboardGui.StudsOffset = studsOffset
							BillboardGui.AlwaysOnTop = true
							BillboardGui.Enabled = false

							local Frame = Instance.new("Frame")

							Frame.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
							Frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20)
							Frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
							Frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
							Frame.Parent = BillboardGui
							Instance.new("UICorner", Frame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

							local parent = Instance.new("Frame")

							parent.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1)
							parent.BackgroundColor3 = backgroundColor3
							parent.BorderSizePixel = 0
							parent.Parent = Frame
							Instance.new("UICorner", parent).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

							local UIGradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")

							UIGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new({
								ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, backgroundColor3),
								ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.new(1, 1, 1)),
							})
							UIGradient.Parent = parent

							local TextLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")

							TextLabel.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
							TextLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
							TextLabel.Text = textLabel
							TextLabel.TextScaled = true
							TextLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
							TextLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
							TextLabel.TextTransparency = 0.15
							TextLabel.Parent = Frame
							innerData:protectGUI(BillboardGui)

							return BillboardGui, parent, UIGradient
						end,
						updateSeparation = function(self)
							if self.frontGui then
								self.frontGui.StudsOffset = new(-self.Separation, 3.2, 0)
							end

							if self.sideGui then
								self.sideGui.StudsOffset = new(self.Separation, 3.2, 0)
							end
						end,
						pulse = function(self, secondaryArgument, tertiaryArgument)
							if self[tertiaryArgument] then
								return
							end

							self[tertiaryArgument] = true

							local tween = TweenService:Create(
								secondaryArgument,
								TweenInfo.new(0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, 2, true),
								{
									BackgroundTransparency = 0.3,
								}
							)

							tween:Play()
							tween.Completed:Once(function()
								self[tertiaryArgument] = false
							end)
						end,
						initialize = function(enabledState)
							local sideBarState = enabledState
							pcall(function()
								local humanoidContainer = LocalPlayer.Character or LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Wait(5)
								local HumanoidRootPart = humanoidContainer:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
								local flag = not HumanoidRootPart
								local Humanoid = humanoidContainer:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)

								if not flag then
									flag = not Humanoid
								end

								if flag then
									return
								end

								local Animator = Humanoid:WaitForChild("Animator", 5)

								if not Animator then
									return
								end

								local frontGuiState = sideBarState
								local frontBarState = sideBarState
								local frontGradState = sideBarState
								local enabledState = sideBarState
								local fromRgbResult = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80)
								local frontGuiData = { new(-sideBarState.Separation, 3.2, 0) }
								local frontGui, frontBar, frontGrad = enabledState:createCooldownGui(
									fromRgbResult,
									"FRONT DASH",
									unpackValues(frontGuiData)
								)

								frontGuiState.frontGui = frontGui
								frontBarState.frontBar = frontBar
								frontGradState.frontGrad = frontGrad

								local sideGuiState = sideBarState
								local sideTimeState = sideBarState
								local sideGradState = sideBarState
								local frontTimeState = sideBarState
								local secondaryFromRgbResult = Color3.fromRGB(80, 150, 255)
								local sideGuiData = { new(sideBarState.Separation, 3.2, 0) }
								local sideGui, sideBar, sideGrad = frontTimeState:createCooldownGui(
									secondaryFromRgbResult,
									"SIDE DASH",
									unpackValues(sideGuiData)
								)

								sideGuiState.sideGui = sideGui
								sideTimeState.sideBar = sideBar
								sideGradState.sideGrad = sideGrad
								sideBarState.frontGui.Adornee = HumanoidRootPart
								sideBarState.sideGui.Adornee = HumanoidRootPart
								sideBarState.frontGui.Parent = PlayerGui
								sideBarState.sideGui.Parent = PlayerGui
								sideBarState.frontGui.Enabled = sideBarState.Enabled
								sideBarState.sideGui.Enabled = sideBarState.Enabled
								Animator.AnimationPlayed:Connect(function(animation)
									if not sideBarState.Enabled or not animation.Animation then
										return
									end

									local AnimationId = animation.Animation.AnimationId

									if AnimationId == sideBarState.FRONT_DASH_ANIM then
										sideBarState.frontTime = sideBarState.FRONT_COOLDOWN
										sideBarState._frontProg = 0
										sideBarState.frontBar.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1)
										sideBarState.frontPulseActive = false

										return
									end

									if sideBarState.SIDE_DASH_ANIMS[AnimationId] then
										sideBarState.sideTime = sideBarState.SIDE_COOLDOWN
										sideBarState._sideProg = 0
										sideBarState.sideBar.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1)
										sideBarState.sidePulseActive = false
									end
								end)
							end)
						end,
						update = function(self, sideTimeNumber)
							if not self.Enabled or (not self.frontBar or not self.sideBar) then
								return
							end

							self._gradFrame = self._gradFrame + 1

							local ThrottleFactor = lastTimeData.ThrottleFactor
							local isGradFrame = self._gradFrame % (4 * ThrottleFactor) == 0
							local secondaryIsGradFrame = self._gradFrame % ThrottleFactor == 0

							if self.frontTime > 0 then
								self.frontTime = max(0, self.frontTime - sideTimeNumber)

								if secondaryIsGradFrame then
									local frontProg = 1 - self.frontTime / self.FRONT_COOLDOWN

									self._frontProg = frontProg
									self.frontBar.Size = UDim2.fromScale(frontProg, 1)

									if isGradFrame and self.frontGrad then
										self.frontGrad.Rotation = self.frontGrad.Rotation + 4
									end
								end
							elseif self._frontProg >= 0.99 then
								self:pulse(self.frontBar, "frontPulseActive")
							end

							if self.sideTime > 0 then
								self.sideTime = max(0, self.sideTime - sideTimeNumber)

								if secondaryIsGradFrame then
									local sideProg = 1 - self.sideTime / self.SIDE_COOLDOWN

									self._sideProg = sideProg
									self.sideBar.Size = UDim2.fromScale(sideProg, 1)

									if isGradFrame and self.sideGrad then
										self.sideGrad.Rotation = self.sideGrad.Rotation + 8

										return
									end
								end
							elseif self._sideProg >= 0.99 then
								self:pulse(self.sideBar, "sidePulseActive")
							end
						end,
						toggle = function(self, enabled)
							self.Enabled = enabled
							pcall(function()
								if enabled then
									if not self.frontGui then
										self:initialize()

										return
									end

									self.frontGui.Enabled = true
									self.sideGui.Enabled = true

									return
								end

								if self.frontGui then
									self.frontGui.Enabled = false
									self.sideGui.Enabled = false
								end
							end)
						end,
					}
					handlerVariantH("DashVisualizer", function(argument)
						updateInstancePropertiesData:update(argument)
					end)

					local active = {
						SaitamaConsecutiveTeleport = false,
						SaitamaNormalConsecutive = false,
						SaitamaM2ShoveDash = false,
						SaitamaFrogjump = false,
						GarouHunterPush = false,
						GarouHunterTeleport = false,
						GarouFlowingDash = false,
						GarouFlowingHunter = false,
						GarouM4Lethal = false,
						GarouM4Flowing = false,
						GarouInstaTwintsFollow = false,
						GarouInstaTwints = false,
						GarouKyoto = false,
						GarouLethalFlowing = false,
						GarouM1HunterGrasp = false,
						MetalFoulGrand = false,
						UniversalMeUp = false,
						UniversalM3Down = false,
						UniversalM3DownProt = false,
						UniversalM1UpDash = false,
						UniversalDashHit = false,
						TechKingM1Up = false,
						TechSupaM1Up = false,
						NinjaM1UpShuriken = false,
					}
					local secondaryConfig = {
						maxCombosSimultaneos = 4,
						heartbeatLimit = 2,
						comboDelay = 0.08,
						autoDisableOnLowFPS = true,
						lowFPSThreshold = 30,
						spamProtection = true,
						spamTimeWindow = 2,
					}
					local queue = {
						active = false,
						queue = {},
						activeCount = 0,
						heartbeatCount = 0,
						connections = {},
					}
					local spamControl = {
						lastExecution = {},
						executionCount = {},
					}
					local pushState = {
						active = false,
						hip = nil,
						conn = nil,
					}

					activeData = {
						Active = active,
						Config = secondaryConfig,
						Queue = queue,
						_m3DownCD = false,
						_m3DownProtCD = false,
						SpamControl = spamControl,
						PushState = pushState,
						dashUsed = false,
						lastFollowTime = 0,
						lastShoveTime = 0,
						lastDashTime = 0,
						getLiveFolder = function(_)
							return handleFlag()
						end,
						checkPerformance = function(self)
							if not self.Config.autoDisableOnLowFPS then
								return true
							end

							if
								(enabledData.enabled and enabledData:getAverageFPS() or 60)
								< self.Config.lowFPSThreshold
							then
								local number = 0
								local next = nextFunction
								local p99Active = self.Active
								local flag
								while true do
									local flagCondition

									flag, flagCondition = next(p99Active, flag)

									if not flag then
										break
									end

									if flagCondition then
										number += 1
									end
								end
								if number > self.Config.maxCombosSimultaneos then
									return false
								end
							end

							return true
						end,
						queueCombo = function(self, name, action, usesHeartbeat)
							if self.Queue.activeCount >= self.Config.maxCombosSimultaneos then
								return false
							end

							if usesHeartbeat and self.Queue.heartbeatCount >= self.Config.heartbeatLimit then
								return false
							end

							if not durationsData:isReady(name) then
								return false
							end

							if self.Config.spamProtection then
								local number = tickFunction()
								local option = self.SpamControl.lastExecution[name] or 0
								local secondaryNumber = self.SpamControl.executionCount[name] or 0

								if number - option < self.Config.spamTimeWindow then
									if secondaryNumber >= 2 then
										return false
									end

									self.SpamControl.executionCount[name] = secondaryNumber + 1
								else
									self.SpamControl.executionCount[name] = 1
								end

								self.SpamControl.lastExecution[name] = number
							end

							durationsData:trigger(name)
							insert(self.Queue.queue, {
								name = name,
								action = action,
								usesHeartbeat = usesHeartbeat,
							})

							if not self.Queue.active then
								self:processQueue()
							end

							return true
						end,
						processQueue = function(self)
							self.Queue.active = true
							task.spawn(function()
								while
									#self.Queue.queue > 0
									and self.Queue.activeCount < self.Config.maxCombosSimultaneos
								do
									local removeResult = remove(self.Queue.queue, 1)

									self.Queue.activeCount = self.Queue.activeCount + 1

									if removeResult.usesHeartbeat then
										self.Queue.heartbeatCount = self.Queue.heartbeatCount + 1
									end

									pcall(removeResult.action)
									task.wait(self.Config.comboDelay)
									self.Queue.activeCount = self.Queue.activeCount - 1

									if removeResult.usesHeartbeat then
										self.Queue.heartbeatCount = self.Queue.heartbeatCount - 1
									end
								end

								self.Queue.active = false
							end)
						end,
						safeSpawn = function(self, secondaryArgument)
							if not self:checkPerformance() then
								return
							end

							task.spawn(function()
								local success, result = pcall(secondaryArgument)
								if not success then
									warn("Error en combo:", result)
								end
							end)
						end,
					}
				end

				local distData = {}

				function activeData.getClosestTarget(self, input, tertiaryArgument, quaternaryArgument)
					if tickFunction() - 0 < 0.15 and distData.closest and quaternaryArgument >= distData.dist then
						return distData.closest
					end
					local dist = distNumber
					local closest
					local liveFolder = self:getLiveFolder()
					if not liveFolder then
						return nil
					end
					local next = nextFunction
					local children, secondaryChildren = liveFolder:GetChildren()
					while true do
						local humanoidRootPartContainer

						secondaryChildren, humanoidRootPartContainer = next(children, secondaryChildren)

						if not secondaryChildren then
							break
						end

						if humanoidRootPartContainer:IsA("Model") and humanoidRootPartContainer ~= tertiaryArgument then
							local Humanoid = humanoidRootPartContainer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
							local HumanoidRootPart = humanoidRootPartContainer:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

							if Humanoid and (HumanoidRootPart and Humanoid.Health > 0) then
								local Magnitude = (input.Position - HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude

								if Magnitude < quaternaryArgument and Magnitude < dist then
									dist = Magnitude
									closest = HumanoidRootPart
								end
							end
						end
					end
					distData.closest = closest
					distData.dist = dist

					return closest
				end
				function activeData.hasNearbyTarget(self, humanoidRootPartContainer, tertiaryArgument)
					local input = humanoidRootPartContainer
						and humanoidRootPartContainer:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					local liveFolder = self:getLiveFolder()

					if not input or not liveFolder then
						return false
					end

					local children = liveFolder:GetChildren()

					for i = 1, #children do
						local humanoidContainer = children[i]

						if not (humanoidContainer:IsA("Model") and humanoidContainer ~= humanoidRootPartContainer) then
							continue
						end

						local HumanoidRootPart = humanoidContainer:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
						local humanoidRootPart = HumanoidRootPart
						local Humanoid = humanoidContainer:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")

						if HumanoidRootPart then
							humanoidRootPart = Humanoid and Humanoid.Health > 0
						end

						if
							humanoidRootPart
							and tertiaryArgument >= (HumanoidRootPart.Position - input.Position).Magnitude
						then
							return true
						end
					end

					return false
				end
				function activeData.hasEnemiesInRange(self, humanoidRootPartContainer, productFlag)
					function activeData._isEnemyInvulnerable(_, greenAuraContainer)
						if not greenAuraContainer or not greenAuraContainer.Parent then
							return false
						end

						return greenAuraContainer:FindFirstChild("PerfectBlock") ~= nil
							or (
								greenAuraContainer:FindFirstChild("EsperShield") ~= nil
								or (
									greenAuraContainer:FindFirstChild("HunterMode") ~= nil
									or greenAuraContainer:FindFirstChild("GreenAura") ~= nil
								)
							)
					end

					local input = humanoidRootPartContainer
						and humanoidRootPartContainer:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					local liveFolder = self:getLiveFolder()

					if not input or not liveFolder then
						return false
					end

					local product = (productFlag or 25) * (productFlag or 25)
					local PositionX = input.Position.X
					local PositionZ = input.Position.Z
					local children = liveFolder:GetChildren()

					for i = 1, #children do
						local humanoidContainer = children[i]

						if not (humanoidContainer:IsA("Model") and humanoidContainer ~= humanoidRootPartContainer) then
							continue
						end

						local HumanoidRootPart = humanoidContainer:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
						local Humanoid = humanoidContainer:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")

						if HumanoidRootPart and (Humanoid and Humanoid.Health > 0) then
							local difference = PositionX - HumanoidRootPart.Position.X
							local number = PositionZ - HumanoidRootPart.Position.Z

							if not (product >= difference * difference + number * number) then
								continue
							end

							return true
						end
					end

					return false
				end
				function activeData.resetPushState(self, hipHeightFlag)
					self.PushState.active = false

					if self.PushState.conn then
						self.PushState.conn:Disconnect()
						self.PushState.conn = nil
					end

					if hipHeightFlag and self.PushState.hip then
						pcall(function()
							hipHeightFlag.HipHeight = self.PushState.hip
						end)
						self.PushState.hip = nil
					end
				end
				function activeData.startFollow(self, instance, tertiaryArgument, cFrameCallback)
					self.PushState.hip = tertiaryArgument.HipHeight
					pcall(function()
						tertiaryArgument.HipHeight = tertiaryArgument.HipHeight - 0.5
					end)
					local number = tickFunction()
					local connection
					connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
						if not self.PushState.active or tickFunction() - number > 0.3 then
							connection:Disconnect()
							self:resetPushState(tertiaryArgument)

							return
						end

						pcall(function()
							instance.CFrame = instance.CFrame:Lerp(cFrameCallback(), 0.35)
						end)
					end)
					self.PushState.conn = connection
				end
				function activeData.stickPush(_, input, secondaryInput)
					local number = tickFunction()

					return (
						RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
							if tickFunction() - number >= 0.25 then
								(nil):Disconnect()

								return
							end

							if not secondaryInput or not secondaryInput.Parent then
								(nil):Disconnect()

								return
							end

							pcall(function()
								local difference = secondaryInput.Position - secondaryInput.CFrame.LookVector * 1.5
								local number = new(difference.X, input.Position.Y, difference.Z)
								local product = (number - input.Position).Unit * (6 * dt * 60)

								input.CFrame = input.CFrame:Lerp(cFrameCallback(input.Position + product, number), 0.35)
							end)
						end)
					)
				end
				function activeData.followTarget(_, input, secondaryInput, quaternaryArgument)
					local number = tickFunction()
					local PositionY = input.Position.Y
					local flag = false
					local secondaryFlag = false

					return (
						RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
							if tickFunction() - number >= quaternaryArgument then
								(nil):Disconnect()

								return
							end

							if not input or not input.Parent then
								(nil):Disconnect()

								return
							end

							local difference = input.Position.Y - PositionY

							if not flag and difference < 0.01 then
								flag = true
							end

							if flag then
								secondaryFlag = true
							end

							if secondaryFlag then
								local sum = input.Position + input.AssemblyLinearVelocity * 0.12
								local Magnitude = (sum - secondaryInput.Position).Magnitude
								local clampedValue = clamp(Magnitude / 30, 0.35, 1)
								local secondaryNew = new(sum.X, secondaryInput.Position.Y, sum.Z)

								secondaryInput.CFrame = secondaryInput.CFrame:Lerp(
									cFrameCallback(secondaryInput.Position, secondaryNew),
									0.29 * clampedValue
								)
							end
						end)
					)
				end
				function activeData.setupCharacter(self, humanoidContainer)
					local animConnData = {}

					if self._animConn then
						pcall(function()
							self._animConn:Disconnect()
						end)
						animConnData[1] = self
						animConnData[1]._animConn = nil
					end

					pcall(function()
						local Humanoid = humanoidContainer:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
						local HumanoidRootPart = humanoidContainer:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
						local Animator = Humanoid:WaitForChild("Animator", 5)
						local Communicate = humanoidContainer:FindFirstChild("Communicate")

						if not Communicate then
							return
						end

						local data = {
							["13532604085"] = true,
							["10469639222"] = true,
							["13295919399"] = true,
							["13378751717"] = true,
							["14001963401"] = true,
							["15240176873"] = true,
							["16515448089"] = true,
							["17889471098"] = true,
						}
						local secondaryData = {
							["10503381238"] = true,
							["13379003796"] = true,
						}
						local alternateData = {
							["10480793962"] = true,
							["10480796021"] = true,
						}
						local additionalData = {
							["10470389827"] = true,
							["13935548552"] = true,
						}

						self._animConn = Animator.AnimationPlayed:Connect(function(animation)
							if not animation or not animation.Animation then
								return
							end

							local flag = match(animation.Animation.AnimationId, "%d+")

							if not flag then
								return
							end

							if not self:checkPerformance() then
								return
							end

							if self.Active.SaitamaConsecutiveTeleport and flag == "12510170988" then
								if not self:hasEnemiesInRange(humanoidContainer, 20) then
									return
								end

								self:queueCombo("SaitamaTeleport", function()
									local secondarySelf = self
									local getClosestTarget = secondarySelf.getClosestTarget
									local communicateContainer = humanoidContainer
									local secondaryGetClosestTarget =
										getClosestTarget(secondarySelf, HumanoidRootPart, communicateContainer, 14)

									if not secondaryGetClosestTarget then
										return
									end

									if self:_isEnemyInvulnerable(secondaryGetClosestTarget.Parent) then
										return
									end

									HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = secondaryGetClosestTarget.CFrame * cFrameCallback(0, 3, 0)
								end, false)
							end

							if self.Active.SaitamaNormalConsecutive and flag == "10469630950" then
								if not self:hasEnemiesInRange(humanoidContainer, 20) then
									return
								end

								self:safeSpawn(function()
									local consecutivePunches =
										LocalPlayer.Backpack:FindFirstChild("Consecutive Punches")
									local normalPunch = LocalPlayer.Backpack:FindFirstChild("Normal Punch")

									if consecutivePunches then
										Communicate:FireServer({
											Tool = consecutivePunches,
											Goal = "Console Move",
										})
									end

									task.wait(1.83)

									if normalPunch then
										Communicate:FireServer({
											Tool = normalPunch,
											Goal = "Console Move",
										})
									end
								end)
							end

							if self.Active.SaitamaM2ShoveDash and flag == "10469630950" then
								local lastDashTime = tickFunction()

								if lastDashTime - (self.lastShoveTime or 0) < 10.22 then
									return
								end

								if lastDashTime - (self.lastDashTime or 0) < 1 then
									return
								end

								if not self:hasNearbyTarget(humanoidContainer, 7) then
									return
								end

								self.lastShoveTime = lastDashTime
								self.lastDashTime = lastDashTime
								self:queueCombo("SaitamaShoveDash", function()
									task.delay(0.1, function()
										pcall(function()
											local Shove = LocalPlayer.Backpack:FindFirstChild("Shove")

											if Shove then
												Communicate:FireServer({
													Tool = Shove,
													Goal = "Console Move",
												})
											end
										end)
									end)
									task.delay(0.7, function()
										pcall(function()
											if not self:hasNearbyTarget(humanoidContainer, 7) then
												return
											end

											local communicate = Communicate
											local FireServer = communicate.FireServer
											local W = Enum.KeyCode.W
											local Q = Enum.KeyCode.Q

											FireServer(communicate, {
												Dash = W,
												Key = Q,
												Goal = "KeyPress",
											})
										end)
									end)
								end, false)
							end

							if self.Active.SaitamaFrogjump and flag == "10471336737" then
								if not self:hasEnemiesInRange(humanoidContainer, 50) then
									return
								end

								self:queueCombo("SaitamaFrogjump", function()
									local closestTarget = self:getClosestTarget(HumanoidRootPart, humanoidContainer, 50)

									if not closestTarget then
										return
									end

									task.wait(0.3)
									pcall(function()
										Humanoid:ChangeState(Jumping)
										local difference = closestTarget.Position - HumanoidRootPart.Position
										local unit = new(difference.X, 0, difference.Z)
										if unit.Magnitude > 0.01 then
											unit = unit.Unit
										end
										HumanoidRootPart.Velocity = unit * 20 + new(0, 50, 0)
										local number = tickFunction()
										local connection
										connection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(_)
											if not closestTarget or not closestTarget.Parent then
												connection:Disconnect()

												return
											end

											if tickFunction() - number > 1 then
												connection:Disconnect()

												return
											end

											local Velocity = closestTarget.Velocity
											local sum = closestTarget.Position + new(0, 3, 0)
											local Magnitude = (sum - HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude
											local difference = sum + Velocity * 0.12 - HumanoidRootPart.Position
											local magnitude = difference.Magnitude

											if magnitude < 0.1 then
												return
											end

											local vector = difference.Unit
													* (60 + 120 * clamp(magnitude / 50, 0, 1) ^ 1.5)
												+ Velocity * 0.6

											HumanoidRootPart.Velocity = HumanoidRootPart.Velocity:Lerp(
												new(vector.X, HumanoidRootPart.Velocity.Y, vector.Z),
												0.18
											)

											if Magnitude < 1.5 then
												HumanoidRootPart.Velocity =
													HumanoidRootPart.Velocity:Lerp(Velocity + new(0, 2, 0), 0.4)
											end
										end)
									end)
								end, false)
							end

							if self.Active.GarouHunterPush and flag == "12309835105" then
								if self.PushState.active then
									return
								end

								if not self:hasEnemiesInRange(humanoidContainer, 20) then
									return
								end

								local closestTarget = self:getClosestTarget(HumanoidRootPart, humanoidContainer, 20)

								if closestTarget then
									closestTarget = self:_isEnemyInvulnerable(closestTarget.Parent)
								end

								if closestTarget then
									return
								end

								self:queueCombo("GarouHunterPush", function()
									self.PushState.active = true
									task.delay(1, function()
										if not self.PushState.active then
											return
										end

										pcall(function()
											HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = HumanoidRootPart.CFrame
												+ HumanoidRootPart.CFrame.LookVector * 15
											self:startFollow(HumanoidRootPart, Humanoid, function()
												return HumanoidRootPart.CFrame + HumanoidRootPart.CFrame.LookVector * 3
											end)
										end)
									end)
									animation.Stopped:Once(function()
										self:resetPushState(Humanoid)
									end)
								end, true)
							end

							if self.Active.GarouHunterTeleport and flag == "12309835105" then
								if not self:hasEnemiesInRange(humanoidContainer, 20) then
									return
								end

								self:queueCombo("GarouHunterTeleport", function()
									task.delay(1, function()
										pcall(function()
											HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = HumanoidRootPart.CFrame
												+ HumanoidRootPart.CFrame.LookVector * 15
										end)
									end)
								end, false)
							end

							if self.Active.GarouFlowingDash and flag == "12273188754" then
								if not self:hasEnemiesInRange(humanoidContainer, 20) then
									return
								end

								self:queueCombo("GarouFlowingDash", function()
									task.delay(1.6, function()
										pcall(function()
											local communicate = Communicate
											local W = Enum.KeyCode.W
											local Q = Enum.KeyCode.Q

											communicate:FireServer({
												Dash = W,
												Key = Q,
												Goal = "KeyPress",
											})
										end)
									end)
								end, false)
							end

							if self.Active.GarouFlowingHunter and flag == "12273188754" then
								if not self:hasEnemiesInRange(humanoidContainer, 20) then
									return
								end

								self:queueCombo("GarouFlowingHunter", function()
									task.delay(1.8, function()
										pcall(function()
											HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = HumanoidRootPart.CFrame
												+ HumanoidRootPart.CFrame.LookVector * 20

											local hunterSGrasp = LocalPlayer.Backpack:FindFirstChild("Hunter's Grasp")

											if hunterSGrasp then
												Communicate:FireServer({
													Tool = hunterSGrasp,
													Goal = "Console Move",
												})
											end
										end)
									end)
								end, false)
							end

							if self.Active.GarouM4Lethal and flag == "13294471966" then
								if not self:hasEnemiesInRange(humanoidContainer, 20) then
									return
								end

								local closestTarget = self:getClosestTarget(HumanoidRootPart, humanoidContainer, 20)

								if closestTarget and self:_isEnemyInvulnerable(closestTarget.Parent) then
									return
								end

								self:queueCombo("GarouM4Lethal", function()
									task.wait(0.3)
									pcall(function()
										local lethalWhirlwindStream =
											LocalPlayer.Backpack:FindFirstChild("Lethal Whirlwind Stream")

										if lethalWhirlwindStream then
											Communicate:FireServer({
												Tool = lethalWhirlwindStream,
												Goal = "Console Move",
											})
										end

										HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = HumanoidRootPart.CFrame
											+ HumanoidRootPart.CFrame.LookVector * 20
									end)
								end, false)
							end

							if self.Active.GarouM4Flowing and flag == "13294471966" then
								if not self:hasEnemiesInRange(humanoidContainer, 20) then
									return
								end

								self:queueCombo("GarouM4Flowing", function()
									task.wait(0.3)
									pcall(function()
										local flowingWater = LocalPlayer.Backpack:FindFirstChild("Flowing Water")

										if flowingWater then
											Communicate:FireServer({
												Tool = flowingWater,
												Goal = "Console Move",
											})
										end

										HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = HumanoidRootPart.CFrame
											+ HumanoidRootPart.CFrame.LookVector * 20
									end)
								end, false)
							end

							if self.Active.GarouInstaTwintsFollow and flag == "13294471966" then
								local closestTarget = self:getClosestTarget(HumanoidRootPart, humanoidContainer, 35)

								if not closestTarget then
									return
								end

								self:queueCombo("GarouInstaTwintsFollow", function()
									task.delay(0.3, function()
										pcall(function()
											if animation.IsPlaying then
												animation:Stop()
											end

											local communicate = Communicate
											local W = Enum.KeyCode.W
											local Q = Enum.KeyCode.Q

											communicate:FireServer({
												Dash = W,
												Key = Q,
												Goal = "KeyPress",
											})

											if tickFunction() - (self.lastFollowTime or 0) < 4.9 then
												return
											end

											self.lastFollowTime = tickFunction()
											task.delay(0.69, function()
												self:stickPush(HumanoidRootPart, closestTarget)
											end)
										end)
									end)
								end, true)
							end

							if self.Active.GarouInstaTwints and flag == "13294471966" then
								if not self:hasEnemiesInRange(humanoidContainer, 20) then
									return
								end

								self:queueCombo("GarouInstaTwints", function()
									task.delay(0.3, function()
										pcall(function()
											if animation.IsPlaying then
												animation:Stop()
											end

											local communicate = Communicate
											local W = Enum.KeyCode.W
											local Q = Enum.KeyCode.Q

											communicate:FireServer({
												Dash = W,
												Key = Q,
												Goal = "KeyPress",
											})
										end)
									end)
								end, false)
							end

							if self.Active.GarouKyoto and flag == "12273188754" then
								if not self:hasEnemiesInRange(humanoidContainer, 20) then
									return
								end

								self:queueCombo("GarouKyoto", function()
									task.delay(1.55, function()
										pcall(function()
											local lethalWhirlwindStream =
												LocalPlayer.Backpack:FindFirstChild("Lethal Whirlwind Stream")

											if lethalWhirlwindStream then
												Communicate:FireServer({
													Tool = lethalWhirlwindStream,
													Goal = "Console Move",
												})
											end

											HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = HumanoidRootPart.CFrame
												+ HumanoidRootPart.CFrame.LookVector * 26
										end)
									end)
								end, false)
							end

							if
								self.Active.GarouLethalFlowing
								and flag == "12296113986"
								and self:hasEnemiesInRange(humanoidContainer, 20)
							then
								self:queueCombo("GarouLethalFlowing", function()
									pcall(function()
										animation.Stopped:Wait()
										task.wait(0.1)

										local flowingWater = LocalPlayer.Backpack:FindFirstChild("Flowing Water")

										if flowingWater then
											Communicate:FireServer({
												Goal = "Console Move",
												IsAutoActivate = true,
												Tool = flowingWater,
											})
										end
									end)
								end, false)
							end

							if self.Active.GarouM1HunterGrasp and secondaryData[flag] then
								local closestTarget = self:getClosestTarget(HumanoidRootPart, humanoidContainer, 30)

								if closestTarget then
									self:queueCombo("GarouM1HunterGrasp", function()
										task.wait(0.4)
										pcall(function()
											local input = self:getClosestTarget(HumanoidRootPart, humanoidContainer, 30)
												or closestTarget

											HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = cFrameCallback(input.Position + new(0, 5, 0))

											local hunterSGrasp = LocalPlayer.Backpack:FindFirstChild("Hunter's Grasp")

											if hunterSGrasp then
												Communicate:FireServer({
													Goal = "Console Move",
													IsAutoActivate = true,
													Tool = hunterSGrasp,
												})
											end
										end)
									end, false)
								end
							end

							if self.Active.NinjaM1UpShuriken and secondaryData[flag] then
								if self.Active.GarouHunterPush or self.Active.GarouHunterTeleport then
									return
								end

								if self:getClosestTarget(HumanoidRootPart, humanoidContainer, 15) then
									self:queueCombo("NinjaM1UpShuriken", function()
										task.wait(0.35)
										pcall(function()
											Communicate:FireServer({
												Goal = "Record Jump",
											})
											Humanoid:ChangeState(Jumping)
											HumanoidRootPart.Velocity =
												new(HumanoidRootPart.Velocity.X, 60, HumanoidRootPart.Velocity.Z)

											local explosiveShuriken =
												LocalPlayer.Backpack:FindFirstChild("Explosive Shuriken")

											Communicate:FireServer({
												Goal = "Console Move",
												IsAutoActivate = true,
												Tool = explosiveShuriken,
											})
										end)
									end, false)
								end
							end

							if self.Active.MetalFoulGrand and flag == "14705929107" then
								if not self:hasEnemiesInRange(humanoidContainer, 20) then
									return
								end

								self:queueCombo("MetalFoulGrand", function()
									task.delay(2.6, function()
										pcall(function()
											local grandSlam = LocalPlayer.Backpack:FindFirstChild("Grand Slam")

											if grandSlam then
												Communicate:FireServer({
													Tool = grandSlam,
													Goal = "Console Move",
												})
											end
										end)
									end)
								end, false)
							end

							if self.Active.UniversalMeUp and data[flag] then
								if not self:hasEnemiesInRange(humanoidContainer, 25) then
									return
								end

								self:queueCombo("UniversalMeUp", function()
									pcall(function()
										Communicate:FireServer({
											Goal = "Record Jump",
										})
										task.wait(0.05)

										local communicate = Communicate
										local KeyCode = Enum.KeyCode
										local FireServer = communicate.FireServer
										local Space = KeyCode.Space

										FireServer(communicate, {
											Goal = "KeyPress",
											Key = Space,
										})
										task.wait(0.05)
										Communicate:FireServer({
											Goal = "LeftClick",
											Mobile = true,
										})
									end)
								end, false)
							end

							if
								self.Active.UniversalM3Down
								and data[flag]
								and (self:hasEnemiesInRange(humanoidContainer, 25) and not self._m3DownCD)
							then
								self._m3DownCD = true
								task.delay(1.2, function()
									self._m3DownCD = false
								end)
								self:queueCombo("UniversalM3Down", function()
									pcall(function()
										Humanoid:ChangeState(Jumping)
										HumanoidRootPart.Velocity =
											new(HumanoidRootPart.Velocity.X, 50, HumanoidRootPart.Velocity.Z)
										task.wait(0.35)
										Communicate:FireServer({
											Goal = "LeftClick",
											Mobile = true,
										})
										Communicate:FireServer({
											Goal = "LeftClick",
											Mobile = true,
										})
									end)
								end, false)
							end

							if
								self.Active.UniversalM3DownProt
								and data[flag]
								and (self:hasEnemiesInRange(humanoidContainer, 25) and not self._m3DownProtCD)
							then
								local condition = handleFlag()
								local flag = false

								if condition then
									for _, humanoidRootPartContainer in ipairsFunction(condition:GetChildren()) do
										if
											humanoidRootPartContainer:IsA("Model")
											and humanoidRootPartContainer.Name ~= LocalPlayer.Name
										then
											local humanoidRootPart =
												humanoidRootPartContainer:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

											if
												humanoidRootPart
												and (HumanoidRootPart.Position - humanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude
													<= 25
											then
												local humanoid =
													humanoidRootPartContainer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

												if humanoid then
													local GetPlayingAnimationTracks = humanoid.GetPlayingAnimationTracks

													for _, item in ipairsFunction(GetPlayingAnimationTracks(humanoid)) do
														if not item.Animation then
															continue
														end

														local matchResult = match(item.Animation.AnimationId, "%d+")

														if matchResult and additionalData[matchResult] then
															flag = true

															break
														end
													end
												end
											end
										end

										if flag then
											break
										end
									end
								end

								if flag then
									self._m3DownProtCD = true
									task.delay(1.2, function()
										self._m3DownProtCD = false
									end)
									self:queueCombo("UniversalM3DownProt", function()
										pcall(function()
											Humanoid:ChangeState(Jumping)
											HumanoidRootPart.Velocity =
												new(HumanoidRootPart.Velocity.X, 50, HumanoidRootPart.Velocity.Z)
											task.wait(0.35)
											Communicate:FireServer({
												Goal = "LeftClick",
												Mobile = true,
											})
											Communicate:FireServer({
												Goal = "LeftClick",
												Mobile = true,
											})
										end)
									end, false)
								end
							end

							if self.Active.UniversalM1UpDash and secondaryData[flag] then
								local closestTarget = self:getClosestTarget(HumanoidRootPart, humanoidContainer, 30)

								if not closestTarget then
									return
								end

								self:queueCombo("UniversalM1UpDash", function()
									task.delay(0.4, function()
										pcall(function()
											local communicate = Communicate
											local W = Enum.KeyCode.W
											local enum = Enum
											local FireServer = communicate.FireServer
											local Q = enum.KeyCode.Q

											FireServer(communicate, {
												Dash = W,
												Key = Q,
												Goal = "KeyPress",
											})
											self:followTarget(closestTarget, HumanoidRootPart, 1)
										end)
									end)
								end, true)
							end

							if self.Active.UniversalDashHit and alternateData[flag] then
								if self.dashUsed then
									return
								end

								if not self:hasEnemiesInRange(humanoidContainer, 40) then
									return
								end

								self.dashUsed = true
								self:queueCombo("UniversalDashHit", function()
									task.delay(0.05, function()
										pcall(function()
											Communicate:FireServer({
												Goal = "LeftClick",
												Mobile = true,
											})
											task.delay(0.12, function()
												Communicate:FireServer({
													Goal = "LeftClickRelease",
													Mobile = true,
												})
											end)
										end)
									end)
									animation.Stopped:Once(function()
										self.dashUsed = false
									end)
								end, false)
							end

							if self.Active.TechKingM1Up and secondaryData[flag] then
								if not self:getClosestTarget(HumanoidRootPart, humanoidContainer, 30) then
									return
								end

								self:queueCombo("TechKingM1Up", function()
									task.wait(0.35)
									pcall(function()
										Humanoid:ChangeState(Jumping)
										HumanoidRootPart.Velocity =
											new(HumanoidRootPart.Velocity.X, 60, HumanoidRootPart.Velocity.Z)
										local communicate = Communicate
										local W = Enum.KeyCode.W
										local Q = Enum.KeyCode.Q
