										communicate:FireServer({
											Dash = W,
											Key = Q,
											Goal = "KeyPress",
										})
										local quotient
										pcall(function()
											quotient = Stats.Network.ServerStatsItem["Data Ping"]:GetValue() / 1000
										end)
										local clampedValue = clamp(0.19, 0.05, 0.35)
										task.delay(clampedValue, function()
											local currentCamera = workspace.CurrentCamera

											if not currentCamera then
												return
											end

											local cFrame = currentCamera.CFrame
											local LookVector = cFrame.LookVector
											local vector = new(LookVector.X, 0, LookVector.Z)

											if vector.Magnitude < 0.01 then
												return
											end

											local secondaryVector = -vector.Unit
											local number = new(secondaryVector.X, LookVector.Y, secondaryVector.Z)

											currentCamera.CFrame =
												cFrameCallback(cFrame.Position, cFrame.Position + number)
										end)
									end)
								end, false)
							end

							if self.Active.TechSupaM1Up and secondaryData[flag] then
								local closestTarget = self:getClosestTarget(HumanoidRootPart, humanoidContainer, 40)

								if not closestTarget then
									return
								end

								self:queueCombo("TechSupaM1Up", function()
									task.delay(0.4, function()
										pcall(function()
											local communicate = Communicate
											local W = Enum.KeyCode.W
											local Q = Enum.KeyCode.Q
											communicate:FireServer({
												Dash = W,
												Key = Q,
												Goal = "KeyPress",
											})
											local number = new(0, 0, 0)
											local differenceNumber = tickFunction()
											local connection
											connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
												if not HumanoidRootPart or not HumanoidRootPart.Parent then
													handlerVariantI(connection)

													return
												end

												local difference = tickFunction() - differenceNumber

												if difference >= 0.7 then
													handlerVariantI(connection)

													return
												end

												if not closestTarget or not closestTarget.Parent then
													handlerVariantI(connection)

													return
												end

												if closestTarget.Parent:FindFirstChild("RecentM1Hit") then
													handlerVariantI(connection)
													pcall(function()
														Humanoid.PlatformStand = false
														Humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall)
														HumanoidRootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = new(0, 0, 0)
													end)

													return
												end

												pcall(function()
													local AssemblyLinearVelocity = closestTarget.AssemblyLinearVelocity
													local secondaryDifference = AssemblyLinearVelocity - number
													local Value
													pcall(function()
														Value = Stats.Network.ServerStatsItem["Data Ping"]:GetValue()
													end)
													local sum = closestTarget.Position
														+ AssemblyLinearVelocity * 0
														+ secondaryDifference * 0
													HumanoidRootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = new(0, 0, 0)
													local alternateDifference = 0.7 - difference
													if alternateDifference <= 0.18 then
														local difference = 1 - alternateDifference / 0.18
														local product = difference * 3.141592653589793

														HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = lookAt(
															new(
																sum.X + cos(product) * 1.8,
																sum.Y + 3.5 * difference,
																sum.Z + sin(product) * 1.8
															),
															sum
														)
													else
														HumanoidRootPart.CFrame =
															lookAt(new(sum.X, sum.Y - 2.8, sum.Z), sum)
													end
												end)
											end)
										end)
									end)
								end, false)
							end
						end)
					end)
				end
				function activeData.cleanup(self)
					if self.PushState.conn then
						self.PushState.conn:Disconnect()
						self.PushState.conn = nil
					end

					self.Queue.queue = {}
					self.Queue.activeCount = 0
					self.Queue.heartbeatCount = 0
					self.SpamControl.lastExecution = {}
					self.SpamControl.executionCount = {}
					self.dashUsed = false
					self.PushState.active = false
				end

				currentValueData = {
					Active = {
						HammerHeelM4 = false,
						BindingClothM4 = false,
						HammerHeelPush = false,
					},
				}

				local radiusData = {}

				function currentValueData.hasNearbyTarget(_, humanoidRootPartContainer, radius)
					local humanoidRootPart = humanoidRootPartContainer

					if humanoidRootPartContainer then
						humanoidRootPart = humanoidRootPartContainer:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					end

					local childrenFlag = handleFlag()

					if not humanoidRootPart or not childrenFlag then
						return false
					end

					if tickFunction() - 0 < 0.1 and radius == radiusData.radius then
						return radiusData.result or false
					end

					local children = childrenFlag:GetChildren()

					for i = 1, #children do
						local humanoidContainer = children[i]

						if not (humanoidContainer:IsA("Model") and humanoidContainer ~= humanoidRootPartContainer) then
							continue
						end

						local HumanoidRootPart = humanoidContainer:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
						local Humanoid = humanoidContainer:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")

						if
							HumanoidRootPart
							and (Humanoid and Humanoid.Health > 0)
							and radius >= (HumanoidRootPart.Position - humanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude
						then
							radiusData.result = true
							radiusData.radius = radius

							return true
						end
					end

					radiusData.result = false
					radiusData.radius = radius

					return false
				end
				function currentValueData.setupCharacter(self, humanoidContainer)
					if self._animConn then
						pcall(function()
							self._animConn:Disconnect()
						end)
						self._animConn = nil
					end

					pcall(function()
						local Humanoid = humanoidContainer:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
						local HumanoidRootPart = humanoidContainer:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
						local Animator = Humanoid:WaitForChild("Animator", 5)
						local Communicate = humanoidContainer:FindFirstChild("Communicate")

						if not Communicate then
							return
						end

						self._animConn = Animator.AnimationPlayed:Connect(function(animation)
							if not animation or not animation.Animation then
								return
							end

							local flag = match(animation.Animation.AnimationId, "%d+")

							if not flag then
								return
							end

							if
								self.Active.HammerHeelM4
								and flag == "13294471966"
								and durationsData:isReady("HammerHeelM4")
							then
								durationsData:trigger("HammerHeelM4")
								task.delay(0.3, function()
									pcall(function()
										if not humanoidContainer.Parent then
											return
										end

										if not self:hasNearbyTarget(humanoidContainer, 10) then
											return
										end

										HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = HumanoidRootPart.CFrame
											+ HumanoidRootPart.CFrame.LookVector * 20

										local hammerHeel = LocalPlayer.Backpack:FindFirstChild("Hammer Heel")

										if hammerHeel then
											Communicate:FireServer({
												Tool = hammerHeel,
												Goal = "Console Move",
											})
										end
									end)
								end)
							end

							if
								self.Active.BindingClothM4
								and flag == "13294471966"
								and durationsData:isReady("BindingClothM4")
							then
								durationsData:trigger("BindingClothM4")
								task.delay(0.3, function()
									pcall(function()
										if not humanoidContainer.Parent then
											return
										end

										if not self:hasNearbyTarget(humanoidContainer, 10) then
											return
										end

										HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = HumanoidRootPart.CFrame
											+ HumanoidRootPart.CFrame.LookVector * 20

										local bindingCloth = LocalPlayer.Backpack:FindFirstChild("Binding Cloth")

										if bindingCloth then
											Communicate:FireServer({
												Tool = bindingCloth,
												Goal = "Console Move",
											})
										end
									end)
								end)
							end

							if
								self.Active.HammerHeelPush
								and flag == "109617620932970"
								and durationsData:isReady("HammerHeelPush")
							then
								durationsData:trigger("HammerHeelPush")
								task.delay(0.5, function()
									pcall(function()
										if not humanoidContainer.Parent then
											return
										end

										if not self:hasNearbyTarget(humanoidContainer, 10) then
											return
										end

										local vectorVelocityNumber = -HumanoidRootPart.CFrame.RightVector
										local Attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")

										Attachment.Parent = HumanoidRootPart

										local LinearVelocity = Instance.new("LinearVelocity")

										LinearVelocity.Attachment0 = Attachment
										LinearVelocity.MaxForce = 100000
										LinearVelocity.VelocityConstraintMode = Enum.VelocityConstraintMode.Vector
										LinearVelocity.VectorVelocity = vectorVelocityNumber * 120 + new(0, 18, 0)
										LinearVelocity.Parent = HumanoidRootPart
										Debris:AddItem(LinearVelocity, 0.22)
										Debris:AddItem(Attachment, 0.22)
									end)
								end)
							end
						end)
					end)
				end

				enabledData = {
					Enabled = false,
					running = false,
					Gui = nil,
					Frame = nil,
					Label = nil,
					_frameConn = nil,
					create = function(self)
						self.Gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
						self.Gui.Parent = CoreGui
						self.Gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
						self.Gui.Enabled = false
						innerData:protectGUI(self.Gui)
						self.Frame = Instance.new("Frame")
						self.Frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 140, 0, 65)
						self.Frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.85, 0, 0.1, 0)
						self.Frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20)
						self.Frame.Visible = true
						self.Frame.Active = true
						self.Frame.Draggable = true
						self.Frame.Parent = self.Gui
						Instance.new("UICorner", self.Frame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
						self.Label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
						self.Label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
						self.Label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
						self.Label.TextScaled = true
						self.Label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
						self.Label.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
						self.Label.Parent = self.Frame

						local optionNumber = 0

						self._frameConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
							optionNumber += 1
						end)
						task.spawn(function()
							local differenceNumber = tickFunction()

							while self.running do
								task.wait(0.5)

								if self.Enabled and self.Label then
									local number = tickFunction()
									local difference = number - differenceNumber
									local textOption = difference > 0 and floor(optionNumber / difference) or 0
									local textNumber = floor(LocalPlayer:GetNetworkPing() * 1000)

									self.Label.Text = format("FPS: %d\nPing: %dms", textOption, textNumber)
									differenceNumber = number
									optionNumber = 0
								end
							end

							if self._frameConn then
								self._frameConn:Disconnect()
								self._frameConn = nil
							end
						end)
					end,
					toggle = function(self, enabled)
						self.Enabled = enabled

						if enabled then
							if not self.Gui then
								self.running = true
								self:create()
							end

							if self.Gui then
								self.Gui.Enabled = true

								return
							end
						elseif self.Gui then
							self.Gui.Enabled = false
						end
					end,
				}
				secondaryData = {
					Gui = nil,
					Button = nil,
					Label = nil,
					create = function(self)
						self.Gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
						self.Gui.Parent = CoreGui
						self.Gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
						innerData:protectGUI(self.Gui)
						self.Button = Instance.new("TextButton")
						self.Button.Size = UDim2.new(0, 180, 0, 40)
						self.Button.Position = UDim2.new(0.02, 0, 0.5, 0)
						self.Button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25)
						self.Button.Text = ""
						self.Button.Active = true
						self.Button.Draggable = true
						self.Button.BorderSizePixel = 0
						self.Button.AutoButtonColor = false
						self.Button.Parent = self.Gui
						Instance.new("UICorner", self.Button).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)

						local TextLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")

						TextLabel.Name = "Label"
						TextLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
						TextLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
						TextLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
						TextLabel.Text = "Camlock: OFF 🎯"
						TextLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
						TextLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
						TextLabel.TextScaled = true
						TextLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
						TextLabel.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
						TextLabel.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
						TextLabel.Parent = self.Button
						self.Label = TextLabel
						self.Button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
							enemyData:toggle()
							self:updateUI()
						end)

						local capturedParentName = ""
						local capturedTextOption = -1
						local backgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 180, 0)
						local secondaryBackgroundColor = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 0)
						local alternateBackgroundColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 0)
						local additionalBackgroundColor = Color3.fromRGB(210, 30, 30)
						local fallbackBackgroundColor = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25)
						local nestedBackgroundColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 0)

						task.spawn(function()
							while task.wait(0.2) and (self.Button and self.Button.Parent) do
								local Enemy = enemyData.Enemy

								if Enemy and (Enemy.Parent and Enemy.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")) then
									local Humanoid = Enemy.Parent.Humanoid
									local textOption = Humanoid.MaxHealth > 0
											and floor(Humanoid.Health / Humanoid.MaxHealth * 100)
										or 0
									local ParentName = Enemy.Parent.Name

									if ParentName ~= capturedParentName or textOption ~= capturedTextOption then
										capturedParentName = ParentName
										capturedTextOption = textOption

										local textNumber = floor(LocalPlayer:GetNetworkPing() * 1000)

										self.Label.Text =
											format("🎯 %s | %d%% | %dms", ParentName, textOption, textNumber)
									end

									if textOption >= 75 then
										self.Button.BackgroundColor3 = backgroundColor3
									elseif textOption >= 50 then
										self.Button.BackgroundColor3 = secondaryBackgroundColor
									elseif textOption >= 25 then
										self.Button.BackgroundColor3 = alternateBackgroundColor
									else
										self.Button.BackgroundColor3 = additionalBackgroundColor
									end
								else
									capturedParentName = ""
									capturedTextOption = -1

									if enemyData.State then
										self.Button.BackgroundColor3 = nestedBackgroundColor
										self.Label.Text = "Buscando... 🔎"
									else
										self.Button.BackgroundColor3 = fallbackBackgroundColor
										self.Label.Text = "Camlock: OFF 🎯"
									end
								end
							end
						end)
					end,
					updateUI = function(self)
						if not self.Label then
							return
						end

						if enemyData.State then
							self.Button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 0)
							self.Label.Text = "Buscando... 🔎"

							return
						end

						self.Button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25)
						self.Label.Text = "Camlock: OFF 🎯"
					end,
				}
				valueData = {
					Enabled = false,
					DETECTION_RANGE = 30,
					PREDICTION_SCALE = 0.03,
					MAX_PREDICTION = 15,
					BLOCK_ANIMATION_ID = "rbxassetid://10470389827",
					NEW_BLOCK_ANIMATION_ID = "rbxassetid://13935548552",
					character = nil,
					humanoid = nil,
					animator = nil,
					rootPart = nil,
					shiftLockValue = nil,
					currentHighlight = nil,
					currentTarget = nil,
					_lastHighlightTarget = nil,
					rotationConnection = nil,
					animationConnection = nil,
					deathConnection = nil,
					_cameraConn = nil,
					_cleanup = function(self)
						if self.currentHighlight then
							self.currentHighlight:Destroy()
							self.currentHighlight = nil
						end

						handleInstanceProperties("BlockRotateAssist")
						handlerVariantI(self.rotationConnection)
						self.rotationConnection = nil
						handlerVariantI(self.animationConnection)
						self.animationConnection = nil
						handlerVariantI(self.deathConnection)
						self.deathConnection = nil
						handlerVariantI(self._cameraConn)
						self._cameraConn = nil
					end,
					_isValidTarget = function(_, humanoidRootPartContainer)
						if not humanoidRootPartContainer or not humanoidRootPartContainer.Parent then
							return false
						end

						local Humanoid = humanoidRootPartContainer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
						local HumanoidRootPart = humanoidRootPartContainer:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

						if Humanoid then
							local humanoid = false

							if Humanoid.Health > 0 then
								humanoid = HumanoidRootPart ~= nil
							end

							Humanoid = humanoid
						end

						return Humanoid
					end,
					_getNearestTarget = function(self)
						if not self.rootPart then
							return nil
						end
						if tickFunction() - 0 < 0.1 then
							return nil
						end
						local secondaryHumanoidRootPartContainer
						local DETECTION_RANGE = self.DETECTION_RANGE
						local childrenFlag = handleFlag()
						if not childrenFlag then
							return nil
						end
						local next = nextFunction
						local children, secondaryChildren = childrenFlag:GetChildren()
						while true do
							local humanoidRootPartContainer

							secondaryChildren, humanoidRootPartContainer = next(children, secondaryChildren)

							if not secondaryChildren then
								break
							end

							if
								humanoidRootPartContainer:IsA("Model")
								and humanoidRootPartContainer ~= self.character
								and self:_isValidTarget(humanoidRootPartContainer)
							then
								local HumanoidRootPart = humanoidRootPartContainer:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
								local Magnitude = (self.rootPart.Position - HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude

								if Magnitude <= DETECTION_RANGE then
									secondaryHumanoidRootPartContainer = humanoidRootPartContainer
									DETECTION_RANGE = Magnitude
								end
							end
						end

						return secondaryHumanoidRootPartContainer
					end,
					_applyHighlight = function(self, parent)
						if self.currentHighlight and parent ~= self.currentHighlight.Parent then
							self.currentHighlight:Destroy()
							self.currentHighlight = nil
						end

						if not self.currentHighlight and self:_isValidTarget(parent) then
							local Highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")

							Highlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)
							Highlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)
							Highlight.FillTransparency = 0.5
							Highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
							Highlight.Parent = parent
							self.currentHighlight = Highlight
							innerData:protectGUI(Highlight)
						end
					end,
					_stopRotation = function(self)
						handlerVariantI(self.rotationConnection)
						self.rotationConnection = nil
						handlerVariantI(self._cameraConn)
						self._cameraConn = nil

						if self.shiftLockValue and self.shiftLockValue:IsA("BoolValue") then
							self.shiftLockValue.Value = true
						end
					end,
					_startRotation = function(self, secondaryArgument)
						if not self:_isValidTarget(self.currentTarget) then
							self:_stopRotation()

							return
						end

						local HumanoidRootPart = self.currentTarget:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

						pcall(function()
							if HumanoidRootPart and self.rootPart then
								local currentCamera = workspace.CurrentCamera
								local CFramePosition = currentCamera.CFrame.Position
								local HumanoidRootPartPosition = HumanoidRootPart.Position
								local vector = new(
									HumanoidRootPartPosition.X - CFramePosition.X,
									HumanoidRootPartPosition.Y - CFramePosition.Y,
									HumanoidRootPartPosition.Z - CFramePosition.Z
								)

								if vector.Magnitude > 0.01 then
									currentCamera.CFrame = cFrameCallback(CFramePosition, CFramePosition + vector)
								end
							end
						end)
						self.rotationConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
							if not secondaryArgument.IsPlaying then
								self:_stopRotation()

								return
							end

							local flag = not self.rootPart

							if not flag then
								flag = not self:_isValidTarget(self.currentTarget)
							end

							if flag then
								self:_stopRotation()

								return
							end

							local product = HumanoidRootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity * self.PREDICTION_SCALE

							if product.Magnitude > self.MAX_PREDICTION then
								product = product.Unit * self.MAX_PREDICTION
							end

							local HumanoidRootPartPosition = HumanoidRootPart.Position
							local secondarySelf = self
							local sum = HumanoidRootPartPosition + product

							secondarySelf.rootPart.CFrame =
								lookAt(self.rootPart.Position, new(sum.X, self.rootPart.Position.Y, sum.Z))
						end)
						self._cameraConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
							if not secondaryArgument.IsPlaying then
								handlerVariantI(self._cameraConn)
								self._cameraConn = nil

								return
							end

							if not HumanoidRootPart or (not HumanoidRootPart.Parent or not self.rootPart) then
								handlerVariantI(self._cameraConn)
								self._cameraConn = nil

								return
							end

							pcall(function()
								local currentCamera = workspace.CurrentCamera
								local AssemblyLinearVelocity = HumanoidRootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity
								local rootPartPosition = self.rootPart.Position
								local HumanoidRootPartPosition = HumanoidRootPart.Position
								local vector = new(
									rootPartPosition.X - HumanoidRootPartPosition.X,
									0,
									rootPartPosition.Z - HumanoidRootPartPosition.Z
								)
								local Magnitude = vector.Magnitude
								local clampedValue = 0
								local secondaryVector = new(AssemblyLinearVelocity.X, 0, AssemblyLinearVelocity.Z)

								if Magnitude > 0.1 and secondaryVector.Magnitude > 1 then
									clampedValue = clamp(secondaryVector.Unit:Dot(vector.Unit), 0, 1)
								end

								local product = AssemblyLinearVelocity
									* (self.PREDICTION_SCALE * (1 - clampedValue * 0.95))

								if product.Magnitude > self.MAX_PREDICTION then
									product = product.Unit * self.MAX_PREDICTION
								end

								local sum = HumanoidRootPartPosition + product
								local CFramePosition = currentCamera.CFrame.Position

								currentCamera.CFrame = cFrameCallback(CFramePosition, new(sum.X, sum.Y, sum.Z))
							end)
						end)
					end,
					setupCharacter = function(self, humanoidContainer)
						self:_cleanup()
						self.character = humanoidContainer
						self.humanoid = humanoidContainer:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
						self.animator = self.humanoid and self.humanoid:WaitForChild("Animator", 5)
						self.rootPart = humanoidContainer:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
						self.shiftLockValue = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("ShiftLockOn")
						self.currentTarget = nil
						self._lastHighlightTarget = nil

						if not self.humanoid or (not self.animator or not self.rootPart) then
							return
						end

						self.deathConnection = self.humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
							self:_cleanup()
						end)
						handlerVariantH("BlockRotateAssist", function()
							if not self.Enabled or not self.rootPart then
								return
							end

							local currentTarget = self:_getNearestTarget()

							if currentTarget then
								self.currentTarget = currentTarget

								if currentTarget ~= self._lastHighlightTarget then
									self._lastHighlightTarget = currentTarget
									self:_applyHighlight(currentTarget)

									return
								end
							else
								self.currentTarget = nil
								self._lastHighlightTarget = nil

								if self.currentHighlight then
									self.currentHighlight:Destroy()
									self.currentHighlight = nil
								end
							end
						end)
						self.animationConnection = self.animator.AnimationPlayed:Connect(function(animation)
							if not self.Enabled then
								return
							end

							local option = animation.Animation and animation.Animation.AnimationId

							if option == self.BLOCK_ANIMATION_ID or option == self.NEW_BLOCK_ANIMATION_ID then
								if self.shiftLockValue and self.shiftLockValue:IsA("BoolValue") then
									self.shiftLockValue.Value = false
								end

								self:_startRotation(animation)
							end
						end)
					end,
					start = function(self)
						self.Enabled = true

						if LocalPlayer.Character then
							self:setupCharacter(LocalPlayer.Character)
						end
					end,
					stop = function(self)
						self.Enabled = false
						self:_cleanup()
					end,
				}

					["13294471966"] = true,
