				porCamaraData = {
					Enabled = false,
					RADIO_DETECCION = 35,
					DURACION_DASH = 0.48,
					ANIMACION_DASH_IZQUIERDA = "10480796021",
					ANIMACION_DASH_DERECHA = "10480793962",
					COOLDOWN_DASH = 0.3,
					MAX_DASHES_CONSECUTIVOS = 3,
					PREDICCION_ACTIVADA = false,
					FACTOR_PREDICCION = 8,
					TIEMPO_BASE_PREDICCION = 0.25,
					TIEMPO_MAXIMO_PREDICCION = 0.8,
					TIEMPO_MINIMO_PREDICCION = 0.1,
					PREDICCION_POR_VELOCIDAD = false,
					MOSTRAR_INDICADOR = false,
					INTENSIDAD_GIRO = 8,
					POR_CAMARA = false,
					ORBITA_ACTIVADA = false,
					PROPENSION_ORBITA = 5,
					DISTANCIA_ORBITA_INICIO = 14,
					DISTANCIA_ORBITA_PLENA = 4,
					EMPUJE_ACTIVADO = false,
					NIVEL_EMPUJE = 5,
					CONSTANTE_ACTIVADO = false,
					NIVEL_CONSTANTE = 5,
					personaje = nil,
					humanoide = nil,
					raiz = nil,
					animador = nil,
					animConnection = nil,
					enemigosVivos = {},
					childAddedConn = nil,
					childRemovedConn = nil,
					cachVelocidad = {},
					INTERVALO_CACHE = 0.033,
					HISTORIAL_SIZE = 15,
					objetivoActual = nil,
					estaCurvando = false,
					ultimoTiempoDash = 0,
					dashesConsecutivos = 0,
					tiempoBloqueoObjetivo = 0,
					objetivoBloqueado = nil,
					marcador = nil,
					indicadorPrediccion = nil,
					_renderFrame = 0,
					_pausadoPorCombo = false,
					_pausaSession = 0,
					_enteroADecimal = function(_, quotientNumber)
						local quotient = quotientNumber / 10

						return clamp(quotient, 0.1, 1)
					end,
					_calcularEmpuje = function(_, number)
						return 20 + (clamp(number, 1, 10) - 1) * 14
					end,
					_calcularConstante = function(_, number)
						return 4 + (clamp(number, 1, 10) - 1) * 4
					end,
					_pausarPorCombo = function(self)
						self._pausaSession = self._pausaSession + 1

						local pausaSession = self._pausaSession
						local charSession = self._charSession

						if self._pausadoPorCombo then
							return
						end

						self._pausadoPorCombo = true

						local objetivoActual = self.objetivoActual
						local input = objetivoActual and self:_obtenerRaiz(objetivoActual)

						task.spawn(function()
							local number = tickFunction()

							while self._charSession == charSession do
								if pausaSession ~= self._pausaSession then
									return
								end

								if tickFunction() - number >= 2 then
									break
								end

								if self.raiz and (input and input.Parent) then
									local Magnitude = (input.Position - self.raiz.Position).Magnitude
									local dodgevelocity = self.raiz:FindFirstChild("dodgevelocity")

									if
										dodgevelocity
										and (
											dodgevelocity:IsA("BodyVelocity")
											and (dodgevelocity.Velocity.Magnitude > 5 and Magnitude < 2)
										)
									then
										break
									end
								end

								RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
							end

							if pausaSession == self._pausaSession and self._charSession == charSession then
								self._pausadoPorCombo = false
							end
						end)
					end,
					_aplicarBoostDash = function(self)
						if not self.EMPUJE_ACTIVADO and not self.CONSTANTE_ACTIVADO then
							return
						end

						if self._pausadoPorCombo then
							return
						end

						local raiz = self.raiz
						local charSession = self._charSession

						task.spawn(function()
							local number = tickFunction()
							local dodgevelocity
							while tickFunction() - number < 0.25 do
								if self._charSession ~= charSession then
									return
								end

								if not raiz or not raiz.Parent then
									return
								end

								dodgevelocity = raiz:FindFirstChild("dodgevelocity")

								if dodgevelocity and dodgevelocity:IsA("BodyVelocity") then
									break
								end

								RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
							end
							if not dodgevelocity then
								return
							end
							if self.EMPUJE_ACTIVADO then
								local velocityNumber = self:_calcularEmpuje(self.NIVEL_EMPUJE)
								local sum = 0.06 + (self.NIVEL_EMPUJE - 1) * 0.015
								local number = tickFunction()

								while
									sum > tickFunction() - number
									and self._charSession == charSession
									and (dodgevelocity and dodgevelocity.Parent)
								do
									local dodgevelocityVelocity = dodgevelocity.Velocity
									local Magnitude = dodgevelocityVelocity.Magnitude

									if Magnitude < 1 then
										break
									end

									dodgevelocity.Velocity = dodgevelocityVelocity.Unit * (Magnitude + velocityNumber)
									RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
								end
							end
							if self.CONSTANTE_ACTIVADO then
								local velocityNumber = self:_calcularConstante(self.NIVEL_CONSTANTE)
								local number = tickFunction()

								while
									tickFunction() - number < self.DURACION_DASH
									and self._charSession == charSession
									and (dodgevelocity and dodgevelocity.Parent)
								do
									local dodgevelocityVelocity = dodgevelocity.Velocity
									local Magnitude = dodgevelocityVelocity.Magnitude

									if Magnitude < 1 then
										return
									end

									dodgevelocity.Velocity = dodgevelocityVelocity.Unit * (Magnitude + velocityNumber)
									RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
								end
							end
						end)
					end,
					_createIndicators = function(self)
						if self.marcador then
							pcall(function()
								self.marcador:Destroy()
							end)
						end

						if self.indicadorPrediccion then
							pcall(function()
								self.indicadorPrediccion:Destroy()
							end)
						end

						self.marcador = Instance.new("Highlight")
						self.marcador.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
						self.marcador.FillTransparency = 0.35
						self.marcador.OutlineTransparency = 0
						self.marcador.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
						self.marcador.Enabled = false
						self.marcador.Parent = Workspace
						innerData:protectGUI(self.marcador)
						self.indicadorPrediccion = Instance.new("Part")
						self.indicadorPrediccion.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
						self.indicadorPrediccion.Size = new(2, 2, 2)
						self.indicadorPrediccion.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Bright yellow")
						self.indicadorPrediccion.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
						self.indicadorPrediccion.CanCollide = false
						self.indicadorPrediccion.Anchored = true
						self.indicadorPrediccion.Transparency = 1
						self.indicadorPrediccion.Parent = Workspace
					end,
					_obtenerRaiz = function(_, humanoidRootPartContainer)
						return humanoidRootPartContainer:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					end,
					_objetivoEsValido = function(self, humanoidContainer)
						if not humanoidContainer or not humanoidContainer.Parent then
							return false
						end

						local Humanoid = humanoidContainer:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
						local isHumanoidHealth = self:_obtenerRaiz(humanoidContainer)

						if Humanoid then
							if isHumanoidHealth then
								isHumanoidHealth = Humanoid.Health > 0
							end

							Humanoid = isHumanoidHealth
						end

						return Humanoid
					end,
					_registrarEnemigo = function(self, secondaryArgument)
						if secondaryArgument:IsA("Model") then
							self.enemigosVivos[secondaryArgument] = true
						end
					end,
					_desregistrarEnemigo = function(self, secondaryArgument)
						self.enemigosVivos[secondaryArgument] = nil
					end,
					_setupEnemyTracking = function(self)
						if self.childAddedConn then
							pcall(function()
								self.childAddedConn:Disconnect()
							end)
							self.childAddedConn = nil
						end

						if self.childRemovedConn then
							pcall(function()
								self.childRemovedConn:Disconnect()
							end)
							self.childRemovedConn = nil
						end

						self.enemigosVivos = {}

						local childAddedConnFlag = handleFlag()

						if not childAddedConnFlag then
							return
						end

						for _, item in ipairsFunction(childAddedConnFlag:GetChildren()) do
							self:_registrarEnemigo(item)
						end

						self.childAddedConn = childAddedConnFlag.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
							self:_registrarEnemigo(child)
						end)
						self.childRemovedConn = childAddedConnFlag.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(child)
							self:_desregistrarEnemigo(child)
						end)
					end,
					_obtenerVelocidadEnemigo = function(self, input)
						if not input then
							return new()
						end

						local tiempo = tickFunction()
						local velData = self.cachVelocidad[input]

						if not velData then
							local posArr = {}
							local timeArr = {}

							for i = 1, self.HISTORIAL_SIZE do
								posArr[i] = new()
								timeArr[i] = 0
							end

							velData = {
								vel = new(),
								tiempo = 0,
								posArr = posArr,
								timeArr = timeArr,
								head = 1,
								count = 0,
							}
							self.cachVelocidad[input] = velData
						end

						if tiempo - velData.tiempo < self.INTERVALO_CACHE then
							return velData.vel
						end

						local HISTORIAL_SIZE = self.HISTORIAL_SIZE
						local head = velData.head

						velData.posArr[head] = input.Position
						velData.timeArr[head] = tiempo
						velData.head = head % HISTORIAL_SIZE + 1
						velData.count = min(velData.count + 1, HISTORIAL_SIZE)

						local vel = new()

						if velData.count >= 3 then
							local historialSize = velData.head

							if HISTORIAL_SIZE > velData.count then
								historialSize = (head - velData.count + HISTORIAL_SIZE) % HISTORIAL_SIZE

								if historialSize == 0 then
									historialSize = HISTORIAL_SIZE
								end
							end

							local difference = velData.timeArr[head] - velData.timeArr[historialSize]

							if difference > 0.05 then
								local vector = velData.posArr[head] - velData.posArr[historialSize]

								vel = new(vector.X / difference, 0, vector.Z / difference)
							end
						end

						velData.vel = vel
						velData.tiempo = tiempo

						return vel
					end,
					_obtenerPosicionPredicha = function(self, input, _)
						if not self.PREDICCION_ACTIVADA or not input then
							return input.Position
						end

						local vector = self:_obtenerVelocidadEnemigo(input)
						local Magnitude = vector.Magnitude
						local TIEMPO_BASE_PREDICCION = self.TIEMPO_BASE_PREDICCION

						if self.PREDICCION_POR_VELOCIDAD and Magnitude > 3 then
							TIEMPO_BASE_PREDICCION *= 1 + min(Magnitude / 16, 2) * 0.5
						end

						local product = clamp(
							TIEMPO_BASE_PREDICCION,
							self.TIEMPO_MINIMO_PREDICCION,
							self.TIEMPO_MAXIMO_PREDICCION
						) * self:_enteroADecimal(self.FACTOR_PREDICCION)

						return input.Position + vector * product
					end,
					_buscarMejorObjetivo = function(self)
						local secondaryHumanoidContainer
						local magnitude = distNumber
						if self.POR_CAMARA then
							local ViewportSize = CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
							local magnitudeNumber = secondaryNew(ViewportSize.X / 2, ViewportSize.Y / 2)
							local next = nextFunction
							local enemigosVivos = self.enemigosVivos
							local humanoidContainer
							while true do
								humanoidContainer = next(enemigosVivos, humanoidContainer)

								if not humanoidContainer then
									break
								end

								if humanoidContainer ~= self.personaje then
									local Humanoid = humanoidContainer:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
									local input = self:_obtenerRaiz(humanoidContainer)

									if
										Humanoid
										and (input and Humanoid.Health > 0)
										and (input.Position - self.raiz.Position).Magnitude < self.RADIO_DETECCION
									then
										local vector, condition = CurrentCamera:WorldToViewportPoint(input.Position)

										if condition then
											local Magnitude = (magnitudeNumber - secondaryNew(vector.X, vector.Y)).Magnitude

											if Humanoid.Health < 30 then
												Magnitude *= 0.6
											end

											if Magnitude < magnitude then
												secondaryHumanoidContainer = humanoidContainer
												magnitude = Magnitude
											end
										end
									end
								end
							end

							return secondaryHumanoidContainer
						end
						local next = nextFunction
						local enemigosVivos = self.enemigosVivos
						local humanoidContainer
						while true do
							humanoidContainer = next(enemigosVivos, humanoidContainer)

							if not humanoidContainer then
								break
							end

							if humanoidContainer ~= self.personaje then
								local Humanoid = humanoidContainer:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
								local humanoid = Humanoid
								local input = self:_obtenerRaiz(humanoidContainer)

								if Humanoid then
									humanoid = input and Humanoid.Health > 0
								end

								if humanoid then
									local Magnitude = (input.Position - self.raiz.Position).Magnitude

									if Magnitude < self.RADIO_DETECCION then
										if Humanoid.Health < 30 then
											Magnitude *= 0.6
										end

										if
											self.PREDICCION_ACTIVADA
											and self:_obtenerVelocidadEnemigo(input).Magnitude > 10
										then
											Magnitude *= 0.8
										end

										if Magnitude < magnitude then
											magnitude = Magnitude
											secondaryHumanoidContainer = humanoidContainer
										end
									end
								end
							end
						end

						return secondaryHumanoidContainer
					end,
					_obtenerMejorObjetivo = function(self)
						local tiempoBloqueoObjetivo = tickFunction()

						if
							self.objetivoBloqueado
							and tiempoBloqueoObjetivo - self.tiempoBloqueoObjetivo < 0.5
							and self:_objetivoEsValido(self.objetivoBloqueado)
						then
							local input = self:_obtenerRaiz(self.objetivoBloqueado)
							local option = input and (input.Position - self.raiz.Position).Magnitude

							if option and option < self.RADIO_DETECCION * 1.2 then
								return self.objetivoBloqueado
							end
						end

						local objetivoBloqueado = self:_buscarMejorObjetivo()

						if objetivoBloqueado then
							self.objetivoBloqueado = objetivoBloqueado
							self.tiempoBloqueoObjetivo = tiempoBloqueoObjetivo
						end

						return objetivoBloqueado
					end,
					_esperarVelocidadDash = function(raizArgument)
						local number = tickFunction()

						while tickFunction() - number < 0.25 do
							local dodgevelocity = raizArgument.raiz:FindFirstChild("dodgevelocity")

							if dodgevelocity and dodgevelocity:IsA("BodyVelocity") then
								return dodgevelocity
							end

							RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
						end

						return nil
					end,
					_aplicarCurva = function(self, secondaryArgument)
						if self.estaCurvando then
							return
						end

						if self._pausadoPorCombo then
							return
						end

						if not self.objetivoActual then
							return
						end

						local input = self:_obtenerRaiz(self.objetivoActual)

						if not input then
							return
						end

						local ultimoTiempoDash = tickFunction()

						if ultimoTiempoDash - self.ultimoTiempoDash > 1 then
							self.dashesConsecutivos = 0
						end

						if self.dashesConsecutivos >= self.MAX_DASHES_CONSECUTIVOS then
							return
						end

						self.estaCurvando = true
						self.ultimoTiempoDash = ultimoTiempoDash
						self.dashesConsecutivos = self.dashesConsecutivos + 1

						local raiz = self.raiz
						local charSession = self._charSession

						task.spawn(function()
							local number = tickFunction()
							local dodgevelocity
							while tickFunction() - number < 0.25 do
								if self._charSession ~= charSession then
									self.estaCurvando = false
									self.dashesConsecutivos = max(0, self.dashesConsecutivos - 1)

									return
								end

								if not raiz or not raiz.Parent then
									self.estaCurvando = false
									self.dashesConsecutivos = max(0, self.dashesConsecutivos - 1)

									return
								end

								dodgevelocity = raiz:FindFirstChild("dodgevelocity")

								if dodgevelocity and dodgevelocity:IsA("BodyVelocity") then
									break
								end

								RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
							end
							if not dodgevelocity then
								self.estaCurvando = false
								self.dashesConsecutivos = max(0, self.dashesConsecutivos - 1)

								return
							end
							local differenceNumber = tickFunction()
							while
								tickFunction() - differenceNumber < self.DURACION_DASH
								and self._charSession == charSession
								and (dodgevelocity and dodgevelocity.Parent)
								and (input and input.Parent)
								and (raiz and raiz.Parent)
							do
								local dodgevelocityVelocity = dodgevelocity.Velocity
								local Magnitude = dodgevelocityVelocity.Magnitude

								if Magnitude < 1 then
									break
								end

								local secondaryDodgevelocity = raiz:FindFirstChild("dodgevelocity")
								local numberOption = secondaryDodgevelocity
										and (not not secondaryDodgevelocity:IsA("BodyVelocity") and secondaryDodgevelocity.Velocity.Magnitude)
									or 50
								local number = self.PREDICCION_ACTIVADA
										and self:_obtenerPosicionPredicha(input, numberOption)
									or input.Position
								local raizPosition = raiz.Position
								local secondaryInput = input
								local difference = number - raizPosition
								local magnitude = (secondaryInput.Position - raiz.Position).Magnitude

								if magnitude > self.RADIO_DETECCION then
									break
								end

								local vector = new(difference.X, 0, difference.Z)

								if vector.Magnitude < 0.1 then
									RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
								else
									local Unit = vector.Unit
									local secondaryVector = new(dodgevelocityVelocity.X, 0, dodgevelocityVelocity.Z)

									if secondaryVector.Magnitude < 0.1 then
										RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
									else
										local unit = secondaryVector.Unit
										local newNumber = secondaryArgument ~= "Izquierda" and 1 or -1
										local difference = tickFunction() - differenceNumber
										local sumNumber = sin(difference * 30)

										if self.ORBITA_ACTIVADA then
											local secondaryNew = new(-Unit.Z * newNumber, 0, Unit.X * newNumber)
											local clampedValue = clamp(magnitude * 0.35, 2, 5)
											local number = 0.9 - (self.PROPENSION_ORBITA - 1) / 9 * 0.75
											local secondaryClampedValue = clamp(Magnitude / 50, 1, 2.5)
											local alternateClampedValue =
												clamp(clampedValue * secondaryClampedValue, 2, 12)
											local additionalClampedValue =
												clamp(number / secondaryClampedValue, 0.1, 0.9)
											local power = clamp(
												(self.DISTANCIA_ORBITA_INICIO - magnitude)
													/ (self.DISTANCIA_ORBITA_INICIO - alternateClampedValue),
												0,
												1
											) ^ additionalClampedValue
											local secondaryUnit = Unit:Lerp(
												secondaryNew,
												power * (0.4 + clamp(difference / self.DURACION_DASH, 0, 1) * 0.6)
											).Unit
											local result = if not (magnitude > 18)
												then if not (magnitude > 10)
													then not (alternateClampedValue < magnitude) and 8 or floor(
														6 + power * 2
													)
													else 6
												else 5
											local unitNumber = self:_enteroADecimal(result)
											local secondaryUnitNumber = self:_enteroADecimal(self.INTENSIDAD_GIRO)
											local product = 0.05 * (1 - power * 0.7)
											local sum = sumNumber * product + sin(difference * 73.1) * product * 0.5
											local vector = unit:Lerp(
												secondaryUnit,
												(
													clamp(
														(unitNumber + (secondaryUnitNumber - 0.5) * 0.4 + sum)
															* clamp(secondaryClampedValue, 1, 1.5),
														0.05,
														1
													)
												)
											).Unit

											dodgevelocity.Velocity =
												new(vector.X * Magnitude, dodgevelocityVelocity.Y, vector.Z * Magnitude)
										else
											local secondaryUnit = (Unit + new(-Unit.Z, 0, Unit.X) * newNumber * clamp(
												(magnitude - 5) / 15,
												0,
												0.35
											)).Unit
											local result = if not (magnitude > 18)
												then if not (magnitude > 10) then not (magnitude > 5) and 10 or 8 else 6
												else 4
											local unitNumber = self:_enteroADecimal(result)
											local number = self:_enteroADecimal(self.INTENSIDAD_GIRO)
											local sum = sumNumber * 0.05 + sin(difference * 57.3) * 0.04
											local vector = unit:Lerp(
												secondaryUnit,
												(clamp(unitNumber + (number - 0.5) * 0.4 + sum, 0.05, 1))
											).Unit

											dodgevelocity.Velocity =
												new(vector.X * Magnitude, dodgevelocityVelocity.Y, vector.Z * Magnitude)
										end

										RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
									end
								end
							end
							self.estaCurvando = false
						end)
					end,
					setupCharacter = function(self, personaje)
						self._charSession = (self._charSession or 0) + 1
						handleInstanceProperties("HCDAssist")

						if self.animConnection then
							pcall(function()
								self.animConnection:Disconnect()
							end)
							self.animConnection = nil
						end

						self.personaje = personaje
						self.humanoide = personaje:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
						self.raiz = personaje:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
						self.animador = self.humanoide and self.humanoide:WaitForChild("Animator", 5)

						if not self.humanoide or (not self.raiz or not self.animador) then
							return
						end

						self.estaCurvando = false
						self.objetivoActual = nil
						self.objetivoBloqueado = nil
						self.dashesConsecutivos = 0
						self.ultimoTiempoDash = 0
						self._pausadoPorCombo = false
						self._pausaSession = 0
						self.cachVelocidad = {}

						if self.indicadorPrediccion then
							self.indicadorPrediccion.Transparency = 1
						end

						self._renderFrame = 0
						handlerVariantH("HCDAssist", function()
							if not self.Enabled or not self.raiz then
								return
							end

							if not self.marcador then
								return
							end

							self._renderFrame = self._renderFrame + 1

							local ThrottleFactor = lastTimeData.ThrottleFactor

							if self._renderFrame % ThrottleFactor ~= 0 then
								return
							end

							local objetivoActual = self._renderFrame % (3 * ThrottleFactor) == 0
									and self:_obtenerMejorObjetivo()
								or self.objetivoActual

							if objetivoActual ~= self.objetivoActual then
								self.cachVelocidad = {}
								self.objetivoActual = objetivoActual

								if self.objetivoActual then
									self.marcador.Adornee = self.objetivoActual
									self.marcador.Enabled = true
								else
									self.marcador.Enabled = false
									self.marcador.Adornee = nil

									if self.indicadorPrediccion then
										self.indicadorPrediccion.Transparency = 1
									end
								end
							end

							local PREDICCION_ACTIVADA = self.PREDICCION_ACTIVADA

							if PREDICCION_ACTIVADA then
								PREDICCION_ACTIVADA = self.MOSTRAR_INDICADOR
									and (self.objetivoActual and self.indicadorPrediccion)
							end

							if PREDICCION_ACTIVADA then
								local positionCondition = self:_obtenerRaiz(self.objetivoActual)

								if positionCondition then
									local dodgevelocity = self.raiz:FindFirstChild("dodgevelocity")
									local positionOption = dodgevelocity
											and (not not dodgevelocity:IsA("BodyVelocity") and dodgevelocity.Velocity.Magnitude)
										or 50
									local position = self:_obtenerPosicionPredicha(positionCondition, positionOption)

									self.indicadorPrediccion.Position = position
									self.indicadorPrediccion.Transparency = 0.25

									return
								end
							elseif self.indicadorPrediccion then
								self.indicadorPrediccion.Transparency = 1
							end
						end)
						self.animConnection = self.animador.AnimationPlayed:Connect(function(animation)
							if not self.Enabled then
								return
							end

							if not animation or not animation.Animation then
								return
							end

							local matchResult = match(animation.Animation.AnimationId, "%d+")

							if alternateData[matchResult] then
								self:_pausarPorCombo()

								return
							end

							if
								matchResult == self.ANIMACION_DASH_IZQUIERDA
								or matchResult == self.ANIMACION_DASH_DERECHA
							then
								self:_aplicarBoostDash()
							end

							if self.estaCurvando then
								return
							end

							if matchResult == self.ANIMACION_DASH_IZQUIERDA then
								self:_aplicarCurva("Izquierda")

								return
							end

							if matchResult == self.ANIMACION_DASH_DERECHA then
								self:_aplicarCurva("Derecha")
							end
						end)
						print("✅ HCDAssist V10 configurado: " .. personaje.Name)
					end,
					start = function(self)
						self.Enabled = true
						self:_createIndicators()
						self:_setupEnemyTracking()

						if LocalPlayer.Character then
							self:setupCharacter(LocalPlayer.Character)
						end
					end,
					stop = function(self)
						self.Enabled = false
						self._pausadoPorCombo = false
						self._pausaSession = 0

						if self.animConnection then
							pcall(function()
								self.animConnection:Disconnect()
							end)
							self.animConnection = nil
						end

						handleInstanceProperties("HCDAssist")

						if self.childAddedConn then
							pcall(function()
								self.childAddedConn:Disconnect()
							end)
							self.childAddedConn = nil
						end

						if self.childRemovedConn then
							pcall(function()
								self.childRemovedConn:Disconnect()
							end)
							self.childRemovedConn = nil
						end

						if self.marcador then
							pcall(function()
								self.marcador.Enabled = false
								self.marcador.Adornee = nil
							end)
						end

						if self.indicadorPrediccion then
							pcall(function()
								self.indicadorPrediccion.Transparency = 1
							end)
						end
					end,
				}
				sumData = {
					ENABLED = false,
					ASSIST_ENABLED = false,
					DETECTION_RADIUS = 50,
					SMOOTHING_ENABLED = false,
					SMOOTHING_LEVEL = 5,
					PREDICTION_ENABLED = false,
					PREDICTION_LEVEL = 7,
					SPEED_ENABLED = false,
					SPEED_LEVEL = 5,
					CLOSE_RANGE_DISTANCE = 15,
					CIRCLE_RADIUS = 10,
					CIRCLE_SPEED_MULTIPLIER = 3,
				}
				capturedPart = nil

				function createDashAssistPredPos()
					if capturedPart and capturedPart.Parent then
						return
					end

					local Part = Instance.new("Part")

					Part.Name = "DashAssist_PredPos"
					Part.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
					Part.Size = new(1.6, 1.6, 1.6)
					Part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
					Part.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Cyan")
					Part.CanCollide = false
					Part.Anchored = true
					Part.CastShadow = false
					Part.Transparency = 1
					Part.Parent = Workspace
					capturedPart = Part
					innerData:protectGUI(Part)
				end
				function handlerVariantG()
					if capturedPart then
						pcall(function()
							capturedPart:Destroy()
						end)
						capturedPart = nil
					end
				end

				secondaryNumber = 0

				local animationIdData = {
					["rbxassetid://12351854556"] = true,
					["rbxassetid://10470389827"] = true,
					["rbxassetid://13935548552"] = true,
				}
				local additionalData = {
					duration = 0.5,
					approachSpeed = 18,
					autoAim = 5,
					aimDelay = 0,
				}
				local fallbackData = {
					duration = 0.45,
					approachSpeed = 20,
					autoAim = 6,
					aimDelay = 0,
				}
				local activeDashConfigData = {
					["rbxassetid://10479335397"] = additionalData,
					["rbxassetid://13380255751"] = fallbackData,
					["rbxassetid://13630786846"] = {
						cooldown = 10,
						useAnimationLength = true,
						aimDelay = 0.2,
						approachSpeed = 22,
						autoAim = 9,
						catchAnimation = "rbxassetid://13813099821",
						postCatchAim = 2.1,
					},
				}
				local index = {}

				index.__index = index

				local fillColorFlag = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)
				local fillColorCondition = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)

				additionalNumber = nil

				function index.new()
					local self = setmetatable({}, index)
					local components = setmetatable({}, {
						__mode = "k",
					})

					self.State = {
						target = nil,
						targetModel = nil,
						activeDash = nil,
						activeDashConfig = nil,
						highlight = nil,
						dashConnection = nil,
						trackConnection = nil,
						animationConnection = nil,
						lastUse = {},
						components = components,
						cachedPingValue = 0.04,
						lastPingCheck = 0,
						isCircling = false,
						circleAngle = 0,
						circleDirection = 1,
					}
					self._charSession = 0

					return self
				end
				function index.getComponents(self, humanoidRootPartContainer)
					local flag = self.State.components[humanoidRootPartContainer]

					if flag and (flag.hrp.Parent and flag.hum.Parent) then
						return flag
					end

					local HumanoidRootPart = humanoidRootPartContainer:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					local Humanoid = humanoidRootPartContainer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

					if HumanoidRootPart and Humanoid then
						self.State.components[humanoidRootPartContainer] = {
							hrp = HumanoidRootPart,
							hum = Humanoid,
						}

						return self.State.components[humanoidRootPartContainer]
					end

					return nil
				end
				function index.isAlive(_, condition)
					if condition then
						condition = condition.hrp and (condition.hum and condition.hum.Health > 0)
					end

					return condition
				end
				function index.getCachedPing(self)
					local lastPingCheck = tickFunction()

					if lastPingCheck - self.State.lastPingCheck > 1 then
						local dataPing = Stats.Network.ServerStatsItem:FindFirstChild("Data Ping")

						if dataPing then
							self.State.cachedPingValue = clamp(dataPing:GetValue() / 1000, 0.02, 0.3)
						end

						self.State.lastPingCheck = lastPingCheck
					end

					return self.State.cachedPingValue
				end
				function index.showHighlight(self, instance, condition)
					if condition then
						condition = fillColorCondition
					end

					local fillColor = condition or fillColorFlag

					if self.State.highlight then
						self.State.highlight.Adornee = instance.Parent
						self.State.highlight.FillColor = fillColor
						self.State.highlight.OutlineColor = fillColor

						return
					end

					local Highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")

					Highlight.FillColor = fillColor
					Highlight.OutlineColor = fillColor
					Highlight.FillTransparency = 0.55
					Highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0.3
					Highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
					Highlight.Adornee = instance.Parent
					Highlight.Parent = Workspace
					self.State.highlight = Highlight
					innerData:protectGUI(Highlight)
				end
				function index.removeHighlight(self)
					if self.State.highlight then
						self.State.highlight:Destroy()
						self.State.highlight = nil
					end
				end
				function index.findTarget(self)
					local Character = LocalPlayer.Character
					local input = Character and Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					if not input then
						return nil, nil
					end
					local ViewportSize = CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
					additionalNumber = secondaryNew(ViewportSize.X * 0.5, ViewportSize.Y * 0.5)
					local Position = input.Position
					local product = sumData.DETECTION_RADIUS * sumData.DETECTION_RADIUS
					local magnitudeNumber = distNumber
					local hrp
					local capturedDistNumber = magnitudeNumber
					local capturedI
					local function handler(secondaryI)
						if secondaryI == Character then
							return
						end

						local components = self:getComponents(secondaryI)

						if not self:isAlive(components) then
							return
						end

						local difference = components.hrp.Position - Position

						if difference:Dot(difference) > product then
							return
						end

						local vector, worldToViewportPoint = CurrentCamera:WorldToViewportPoint(components.hrp.Position)

						if not worldToViewportPoint then
							return
						end

						if (secondaryNew(vector.X, vector.Y) - additionalNumber).Magnitude < capturedDistNumber then
							hrp = components.hrp
							capturedI = secondaryI
						end
					end
					local players = Players:GetPlayers()
					for i = 1, #players do
						local secondaryI = players[i]

						if secondaryI ~= LocalPlayer and secondaryI.Character then
							handler(secondaryI.Character)
						end
					end
					local Live = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Live")
					if Live then
						local children = Live:GetChildren()

						for i = 1, #children do
							local secondaryI = children[i]

							if secondaryI:IsA("Model") then
								handler(secondaryI)
							end
						end
					end

					return hrp, nil
				end

				alternateNumber = 0

				function index.isEnemyCountering(self)
					if not self.State.targetModel then
						return false
					end

					alternateNumber += 1

					if alternateNumber < 4 then
						return false
					end

					local Humanoid = self.State.targetModel:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
					local option = Humanoid and Humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")

					if not option then
						return false
					end

					for _, item in ipairsFunction(option:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
						if item.Animation and animationIdData[item.Animation.AnimationId] then
							return true
						end
					end

					return false
				end
				function index.setupEnemyAnimationListener(self)
					if self.State.animationConnection then
						self.State.animationConnection:Disconnect()
					end

					if not self.State.targetModel then
						return
					end

					local Humanoid = self.State.targetModel:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
					local animationConnectionOption = Humanoid and Humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")

					if not animationConnectionOption then
						return
					end

					self.State.animationConnection = animationConnectionOption.AnimationPlayed:Connect(
						function(animation)
							if
								animation.Animation
								and animationIdData[animation.Animation.AnimationId]
								and not self.State.isCircling
							then
								self.State.isCircling = true
								self.State.circleDirection = not (random() > 0.5) and -1 or 1
								self.State.circleAngle = 0
							end
						end
					)
				end
				function index.predictPosition(self, input)
					if not sumData.PREDICTION_ENABLED then
						local _ = input.Position
						local flag = not capturedPart

						if not flag then
							flag = not capturedPart.Parent
						end

						if not flag then
							capturedPart.Transparency = 1
						end

						return input.Position
					end

					local AssemblyLinearVelocity = input.AssemblyLinearVelocity

					if AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude < 1 then
						local _ = input.Position
						local flag = not capturedPart

						if not flag then
							flag = not capturedPart.Parent
						end

						if not flag then
							capturedPart.Transparency = 1
						end

						return input.Position
					end

					local cachedPing = self:getCachedPing()
					local PREDICTION_LEVEL = sumData.PREDICTION_LEVEL
					local Magnitude = AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude
					local sum = 0.04
						+ (clamp(PREDICTION_LEVEL, 1, 10) - 1) * 0.04
						+ clamp(Magnitude / 200, 0, 0.15)
						+ cachedPing
					local clampedValue = clamp(sum, 0, 0.5)
					local position = input.Position + AssemblyLinearVelocity * clampedValue
					local flag = not capturedPart

					if not flag then
						flag = not capturedPart.Parent
					end

					if flag then
						return position
					end

					secondaryNumber += 1

					if secondaryNumber < 3 then
						return position
					end

					capturedPart.Position = position
					capturedPart.Transparency = 0.1 + (sin(tickFunction() * 9) * 0.15 + 0.15)

					return position
				end
				function index.calculateCirclePosition(self, input, _, productNumber)
					local product = sumData.CIRCLE_SPEED_MULTIPLIER * productNumber * 180 * self.State.circleDirection

					self.State.circleAngle = self.State.circleAngle + product

					if abs(self.State.circleAngle) >= 180 then
						self.State.circleAngle = 180 * self.State.circleDirection
						self.State.isCircling = false
					end

					local number = rad(self.State.circleAngle)

					return input.Position
						+ input.CFrame.RightVector * (sin(number) * sumData.CIRCLE_RADIUS)
						+ input.CFrame.LookVector * (-cos(number) * sumData.CIRCLE_RADIUS)
				end
				function index.stopDash(self)
					if self.State.dashConnection then
						pcall(function()
							self.State.dashConnection:Disconnect()
						end)
						self.State.dashConnection = nil
					end

					if self.State.trackConnection then
						pcall(function()
							self.State.trackConnection:Disconnect()
						end)
						self.State.trackConnection = nil
					end

					if self.State.animationConnection then
						pcall(function()
							self.State.animationConnection:Disconnect()
						end)
						self.State.animationConnection = nil
					end

					self.State.activeDash = nil
					self.State.isCircling = false
					self:removeHighlight()

					local flag = not capturedPart

					if not flag then
						flag = not capturedPart.Parent
					end

					if flag then
						return
					end

					capturedPart.Transparency = 1
				end
				function index.applyDash(self, input, secondaryInput, quaternaryArgument, additionalArgument)
					local flagNumber = tickFunction()
					self:showHighlight(secondaryInput, false)
					self:setupEnemyAnimationListener()
					local flag
					local sumNumber
					if sumData.SPEED_ENABLED then
						local SPEED_LEVEL = sumData.SPEED_LEVEL

						sumNumber = (clamp(SPEED_LEVEL, 1, 10) - 1) * 4.4444444444444

						if sumNumber then
							flag = true
						end
					end
					if not flag then
						sumNumber = 0
					end
					flag = false
					local sum = quaternaryArgument.approachSpeed + sumNumber
					task.delay(quaternaryArgument.aimDelay or 0, function()
						if not self.State.activeDash then
							return
						end

						self.State.dashConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
							local flag = tickFunction() - flagNumber > additionalArgument
							if not flag then
								flag = not secondaryInput

								if not flag then
									flag = not secondaryInput.Parent or (not input or not input.Parent)
								end
							end
							if flag then
								self:stopDash()

								return
							end
							if not self.State.isCircling and self:isEnemyCountering() then
								self.State.isCircling = true
								self.State.circleAngle = 0
							end
							local product = (
								(
									if not self.State.isCircling
										then self:predictPosition(secondaryInput)
										else self:calculateCirclePosition(secondaryInput, input, dt)
								) - input.Position
							) * new(1, 0, 1)
							if product.Magnitude < 0.01 then
								return
							end
							local Unit = product.Unit
							local Magnitude = (secondaryInput.Position - input.Position).Magnitude
							local number = 0.12 + quaternaryArgument.autoAim / 10
							if sumData.SMOOTHING_ENABLED then
								local quotient = sumData.SMOOTHING_LEVEL / 10

								number = if not (Magnitude < sumData.CLOSE_RANGE_DISTANCE)
									then clamp(number + quotient * 0.08, 0.05, 0.5)
									else clamp(number - quotient * 0.2, 0.05, 0.5)
							end
							local sumNumber = input.CFrame.LookVector:Lerp(Unit, number)
							local secondaryProduct = sum
								* (self.State.isCircling and sumData.CIRCLE_SPEED_MULTIPLIER or 1)
							local p216Position = input.Position
							local secondarySum = p216Position + sumNumber * secondaryProduct * dt
							pcall(function()
								input.CFrame = cFrameCallback(secondarySum, secondarySum + sumNumber)
							end)
						end)
					end)
				end
				function index.applyPureSpeed(self, movemeContainer, _, secondaryDifferenceNumber)
					if not movemeContainer then
						return
					end

					local SPEED_LEVEL = sumData.SPEED_LEVEL
					local product = (clamp(SPEED_LEVEL, 1, 10) - 1) * 4.4444444444444

					if product <= 0 then
						return
					end

					local charSession = self._charSession

					task.spawn(function()
						local number = tickFunction()
						local moveme
						while tickFunction() - number < 0.25 do
							if self._charSession ~= charSession then
								return
							end

							if not movemeContainer or not movemeContainer.Parent then
								return
							end

							moveme = movemeContainer:FindFirstChild("moveme")

							if moveme and moveme:IsA("BodyVelocity") then
								break
							end

							RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
						end
						if not moveme or not moveme.Parent then
							return
						end
						local differenceNumber = tickFunction()
						while self._charSession == charSession and (moveme and moveme.Parent) do
							local difference = tickFunction() - differenceNumber

							if difference >= secondaryDifferenceNumber then
								return
							end

							local number = 1 - difference / secondaryDifferenceNumber
							local secondaryProduct = product * number
							local movemeVelocity = moveme.Velocity
							local Magnitude = movemeVelocity.Magnitude

							if Magnitude < 1 then
								return
							end

							moveme.Velocity = new(
								movemeVelocity.Unit.X * (Magnitude + secondaryProduct),
								movemeVelocity.Y,
								movemeVelocity.Unit.Z * (Magnitude + secondaryProduct)
							)
							RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
						end
					end)
				end
				function index.onAnimation(self, secondaryArgument, tertiaryArgument)
					local condition = sumData.ENABLED and sumData.ASSIST_ENABLED
					local SPEED_ENABLED = sumData.SPEED_ENABLED

					if not condition and not SPEED_ENABLED then
						return
					end

					if not secondaryArgument.Animation or not secondaryArgument.Animation.AnimationId then
						return
					end

					local AnimationId = secondaryArgument.Animation.AnimationId
					local activeDashConfig = activeDashConfigData[AnimationId]

					if not activeDashConfig then
						return
					end

					if
						activeDashConfig.cooldown
						and tickFunction() - (self.State.lastUse[AnimationId] or 0) < activeDashConfig.cooldown
					then
						return
					end

					local option = activeDashConfig.useAnimationLength and secondaryArgument.Length
						or activeDashConfig.duration

					if condition then
						local State = self.State
						local targetModelState = self.State
						local target, targetModel = self:findTarget()

						State.target = target
						targetModelState.targetModel = targetModel

						if not self.State.target then
							if SPEED_ENABLED then
								self.State.lastUse[AnimationId] = tickFunction()
								self:applyPureSpeed(tertiaryArgument.HumanoidRootPart, activeDashConfig, option)
							end

							return
						end

						self:stopDash()
						self.State.lastUse[AnimationId] = tickFunction()
						self.State.activeDash = AnimationId
						self.State.activeDashConfig = activeDashConfig
						self:applyDash(tertiaryArgument.HumanoidRootPart, self.State.target, activeDashConfig, option)
						self.State.trackConnection = secondaryArgument.Stopped:Once(function()
							self:stopDash()
						end)

						return
					end

					if SPEED_ENABLED then
						self.State.lastUse[AnimationId] = tickFunction()
						self:applyPureSpeed(tertiaryArgument.HumanoidRootPart, activeDashConfig, option)
					end
				end
				function index.initialize(self)
					if self._charAddedConn then
						pcall(function()
							self._charAddedConn:Disconnect()
						end)
						self._charAddedConn = nil
					end

					local function updateAnimationPlayedConnection(humanoidContainer)
						if self._animPlayedConn then
							pcall(function()
								self._animPlayedConn:Disconnect()
							end)
							self._animPlayedConn = nil
						end

						local Humanoid = humanoidContainer:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
						local animPlayedConnCondition = Humanoid and Humanoid:WaitForChild("Animator", 5)

						if animPlayedConnCondition then
							self._animPlayedConn = animPlayedConnCondition.AnimationPlayed:Connect(function(animation)
								self:onAnimation(animation, humanoidContainer)
							end)
						end
					end

					if LocalPlayer.Character then
						updateAnimationPlayedConnection(LocalPlayer.Character)
					end

					self._charAddedConn = LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
						self:stopDash()
						task.wait(0.4)
						updateAnimationPlayedConnection(character)
					end)
				end

				tValue = index.new()

				local targetAnims = {
					["rbxassetid://10470389827"] = true,
					["rbxassetid://13935548552"] = true,
				}

				animConnData = {
					Enabled = false,
					JUMP_VELOCITY = 50,
					DETECTION_RADIUS = 35,
					PROPENSION = 5,
					TARGET_ANIMS = targetAnims,
					_connections = {},
					_saltando = false,
					_liveFolder = nil,
					_hasEnemiesNearby = function(self)
						local liveFolder = self._liveFolder

						if not liveFolder or not liveFolder.Parent then
							liveFolder = handleFlag()
							self._liveFolder = liveFolder
						end

						if not liveFolder then
							return false
						end

						local Character = LocalPlayer.Character

						if not Character then
							return false
						end

						local HumanoidRootPart = Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

						if not HumanoidRootPart then
							return false
						end

						local product = self.DETECTION_RADIUS * self.DETECTION_RADIUS
						local PositionX = HumanoidRootPart.Position.X
						local PositionZ = HumanoidRootPart.Position.Z
						local GetChildren = liveFolder.GetChildren

						for _, humanoidContainer in ipairsFunction(GetChildren(liveFolder)) do
							if not (humanoidContainer:IsA("Model") and humanoidContainer ~= Character) then
								continue
							end

							local humanoidRootPart = humanoidContainer:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
							local Humanoid = humanoidContainer:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")

							if humanoidRootPart and (Humanoid and Humanoid.Health > 0) then
								local difference = PositionX - humanoidRootPart.Position.X
								local number = PositionZ - humanoidRootPart.Position.Z

								if not (product >= difference * difference + number * number) then
									continue
								end

								return true
							end
						end

						return false
					end,
					_applyJump = function(self)
						if self._saltando then
							return false
						end
						local Character = LocalPlayer.Character
						if not Character then
							return false
						end
						local Humanoid = Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
						local HumanoidRootPart = Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
						if not Humanoid or not HumanoidRootPart then
							return false
						end
						if Humanoid.Health <= 0 then
							return false
						end
						self._saltando = true
						Humanoid:ChangeState(Jumping)
						HumanoidRootPart.Velocity =
							new(HumanoidRootPart.Velocity.X, self.JUMP_VELOCITY, HumanoidRootPart.Velocity.Z)
						local connection
						connection = Humanoid.StateChanged:Connect(function(_, newState)
							if newState == Landed or (newState == Running or newState == RunningNoPhysics) then
								self._saltando = false
								handlerVariantI(connection)
							end
						end)

						return true
					end,
					_onAnimationPlayed = function(self, secondaryArgument)
						if not self.Enabled then
							return
						end

						local Animation = secondaryArgument.Animation

						if not Animation then
							return
						end

						if self.TARGET_ANIMS[Animation.AnimationId] then
							if not self:_hasEnemiesNearby() then
								return
							end

							if self.PROPENSION / 10 >= math.random() then
								self:_applyJump()
							end
						end
					end,
					_cleanup = function(self)
						self._saltando = false

						for _, item in ipairsFunction(self._connections) do
							handlerVariantI(item)
						end

						table.clear(self._connections)
					end,
					_setupCharacter = function(self, humanoidContainer)
						self:_cleanup()

						local Humanoid = humanoidContainer:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")

						if not Humanoid then
							return
						end

						local Animator = Humanoid:FindFirstChild("Animator")

						if not Animator then
							return
						end

						local connection = Animator.AnimationPlayed:Connect(function(animation)
							self:_onAnimationPlayed(animation)
						end)

						insert(self._connections, connection)

						local secondaryConnection = Humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
							self:_cleanup()
						end)

						insert(self._connections, secondaryConnection)
					end,
					start = function(self)
						self.Enabled = true
						self._liveFolder = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Live")

						if LocalPlayer.Character then
							self:_setupCharacter(LocalPlayer.Character)
						end
					end,
					stop = function(self)
						self.Enabled = false
						self:_cleanup()
					end,
				}
			end

			additionalUpdateInstancePropertiesData = {
				Enabled = false,
				ANIM_ID = "rbxassetid://10491993682",
				DELAY = 0.4,
				_animConn = nil,
				_charConn = nil,
				_rotateCamera180 = function(_)
					local CurrentCamera = workspace.CurrentCamera

					if not CurrentCamera then
						return
					end

					local CurrentCameraCFrame = CurrentCamera.CFrame
					local LookVector = CurrentCameraCFrame.LookVector
					local vector = new(LookVector.X, 0, LookVector.Z)

					if vector.Magnitude < 0.001 then
						return
					end

					local secondaryVector = -vector.Unit
					local number = new(secondaryVector.X, LookVector.Y, secondaryVector.Z)

					CurrentCamera.CFrame =
						cFrameCallback(CurrentCameraCFrame.Position, CurrentCameraCFrame.Position + number)
				end,
				_connect = function(self, secondaryArgument)
					if self._animConn then
						pcall(function()
							self._animConn:Disconnect()
						end)
						self._animConn = nil
					end

					local Humanoid = secondaryArgument:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
					local animConnOption = Humanoid and Humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")

					if not animConnOption then
						return
					end

					self._animConn = animConnOption.AnimationPlayed:Connect(function(animation)
						if not self.Enabled then
							return
						end

						if not animation.Animation then
							return
						end

						if animation.Animation.AnimationId == self.ANIM_ID then
							task.delay(self.DELAY, function()
								if self.Enabled and animation.IsPlaying then
									pcall(function()
										self:_rotateCamera180()
									end)
								end
							end)
						end
					end)
				end,
				start = function(self)
					self.Enabled = true

					local Character = LocalPlayer.Character

					if Character then
						self:_connect(Character)
					end

					self._charConn = LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
						if self._animConn then
							pcall(function()
								self._animConn:Disconnect()
							end)
							self._animConn = nil
						end

						task.wait(1)

						if self.Enabled then
							self:_connect(character)
						end
					end)
				end,
				stop = function(self)
					self.Enabled = false

					if self._animConn then
						pcall(function()
							self._animConn:Disconnect()
						end)
						self._animConn = nil
					end

					if self._charConn then
						pcall(function()
							self._charConn:Disconnect()
						end)
						self._charConn = nil
					end
				end,
			}
			fallbackUpdateInstancePropertiesData = {
				Enabled = false,
				ancho = 6,
				altura = 5,
				largo = 6,
				_caja = nil,
				start = function(self)
					self.Enabled = true

					local Character = LocalPlayer.Character

					if not Character then
						return
					end

					self:_crearCaja(Character)
				end,
				stop = function(self)
					self.Enabled = false
					handleInstanceProperties("ESPHit")

					if self._caja and self._caja.Parent then
						self._caja:Destroy()
						self._caja = nil
					end
				end,
				_crearCaja = function(self, humanoidRootPartContainer)
					self:stop()
					self.Enabled = true

					local HumanoidRootPart = humanoidRootPartContainer:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)

					if not HumanoidRootPart then
						self.Enabled = false

						return
					end

					local Part = Instance.new("Part")

					Part.Name = "CajaImpactoVisual"
					Part.Anchored = true
					Part.CanCollide = false
					Part.Transparency = 0.5
					Part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
					Part.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
					Part.Size = new(self.ancho, self.altura, self.largo)
					Part.Parent = workspace
					self._caja = Part
					handlerVariantH("ESPHit", function()
						if not self.Enabled then
							self:stop()

							return
						end

						if not humanoidRootPartContainer or not humanoidRootPartContainer.Parent then
							self:stop()

							return
						end

						Part.CFrame = HumanoidRootPart.CFrame * cFrameCallback(0, 0, -(self.largo / 2))
					end)
				end,
				onCharacterAdded = function(self, secondaryArgument)
					if self.Enabled then
						self:_crearCaja(secondaryArgument)
					end
				end,
			}
			LocalPlayer.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function()
				pcall(function()
					tValue:stopDash()
				end)
				pcall(function()
					porCamaraData._charSession = (porCamaraData._charSession or 0) + 1
					porCamaraData.estaCurvando = false
					porCamaraData.objetivoActual = nil
					handleInstanceProperties("HCDAssist")

					if porCamaraData.animConnection then
						porCamaraData.animConnection:Disconnect()
						porCamaraData.animConnection = nil
					end
				end)
				pcall(function()
					valueData:_cleanup()
				end)
				pcall(function()
					enemyData.State = false
					enemyData.Enemy = nil

					if enemyData.Highlight then
						enemyData.Highlight.Enabled = false
						enemyData.Highlight.Adornee = nil
					end
				end)
			end)

			local function updateInstanceProperties()
				pcall(function()
					tValue:stopDash()
				end)
				pcall(function()
					porCamaraData._charSession = (porCamaraData._charSession or 0) + 1
					porCamaraData.estaCurvando = false
					porCamaraData.objetivoActual = nil
					porCamaraData.objetivoBloqueado = nil
					porCamaraData.dashesConsecutivos = 0
					handleInstanceProperties("HCDAssist")

					if porCamaraData.animConnection then
						porCamaraData.animConnection:Disconnect()
						porCamaraData.animConnection = nil
					end
				end)
				pcall(function()
					valueData:_cleanup()
				end)
				pcall(function()
					if valueData.shiftLockValue then
						valueData.shiftLockValue.Value = true
					end
				end)
				pcall(function()
					enemyData.State = false
					enemyData.Enemy = nil

					if enemyData.Highlight then
						enemyData.Highlight.Enabled = false
						enemyData.Highlight.Adornee = nil
					end
				end)
				pcall(function()
					if animConnData._animConn then
						animConnData._animConn:Disconnect()
						animConnData._animConn = nil
					end
				end)
				pcall(function()
					if additionalUpdateInstancePropertiesData._animConn then
						additionalUpdateInstancePropertiesData._animConn:Disconnect()
						additionalUpdateInstancePropertiesData._animConn = nil
					end
				end)
				pcall(function()
					activeData:cleanup()
				end)

				local ipairs = ipairsFunction
				local updateInstancePropertiesData = currentValueData
				local data = secondaryUpdateInstancePropertiesData
				local fallbackUpdateInstancePropertiesData = alternateUpdateInstancePropertiesData

				for _, item in ipairs({
					activeData,
					updateInstancePropertiesData,
					data,
					fallbackUpdateInstancePropertiesData,
				}) do
					local capturedItem = item

					pcall(function()
						if capturedItem._animConn then
							capturedItem._animConn:Disconnect()
							capturedItem._animConn = nil
						end
					end)
				end
			end
			local function secondaryUpdateInstanceProperties(humanoidContainer)
				if not humanoidContainer then
					return
				end

				local Humanoid = humanoidContainer:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
				local HumanoidRootPart = humanoidContainer:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)

				if not Humanoid or not HumanoidRootPart then
					return
				end

				for _, item in ipairsFunction(HumanoidRootPart:GetChildren()) do
					if item:IsA("BodyVelocity") or (item:IsA("BodyGyro") or item:IsA("LinearVelocity")) then
						item:Destroy()
					end
				end

				pcall(function()
					Humanoid.PlatformStand = false
					Humanoid.JumpPower = 50
					Humanoid.WalkSpeed = 16
				end)
				pcall(function()
					if enemyData.State then
						secondaryHandleInstanceProperties("Camlock", function(_)
							enemyData:update()
						end)
					end
				end)
				pcall(function()
					activeData:setupCharacter(humanoidContainer)
				end)
				pcall(function()
					currentValueData:setupCharacter(humanoidContainer)
				end)
				pcall(function()
					secondaryUpdateInstancePropertiesData:setupCharacter(humanoidContainer)
				end)
				pcall(function()
					alternateUpdateInstancePropertiesData:setupCharacter(humanoidContainer)
				end)
				pcall(function()
					if valueData.Enabled then
						valueData:setupCharacter(humanoidContainer)
					end
				end)
				pcall(function()
					if porCamaraData.Enabled then
						porCamaraData:setupCharacter(humanoidContainer)
					end
				end)
				pcall(function()
					if animConnData.Enabled then
						animConnData:_setupCharacter(humanoidContainer)
					end
				end)
				pcall(function()
					if additionalUpdateInstancePropertiesData.Enabled then
						additionalUpdateInstancePropertiesData:_connect(humanoidContainer)
					end
				end)
				pcall(function()
					fallbackUpdateInstancePropertiesData:onCharacterAdded(humanoidContainer)
				end)
				pcall(function()
					if updateInstancePropertiesData.Enabled then
						updateInstancePropertiesData:initialize()
					end
				end)
				Humanoid.Died:Once(function()
					pcall(function()
						tValue:stopDash()
					end)
					updateInstanceProperties()
				end)
			end

			LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
				updateInstanceProperties()
				task.wait(0.5)
				secondaryUpdateInstanceProperties(character)
			end)

			if LocalPlayer.Character then
				task.spawn(function()
					secondaryUpdateInstanceProperties(LocalPlayer.Character)
				end)
			end

			flag = nil
			hbFrameData = {
				Enabled = false,
				_gui = nil,
				_frame = nil,
				_list = nil,
				_labels = {},
				_hbFrame = 0,
				build = function(self)
					if self._gui and self._gui.Parent then
						return
					end

					local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")

					ScreenGui.Name = "CooldownWindowGUI"
					ScreenGui.Parent = CoreGui
					ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
					ScreenGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
					innerData:protectGUI(ScreenGui)

					local Frame = Instance.new("Frame")

					Frame.Name = "CooldownFrame"
					Frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(192, 30)
					Frame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0.45, 0)
					Frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 10)
					Frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.12
					Frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
					Frame.Active = true
					Frame.Draggable = true
					Frame.Visible = false
					Frame.Parent = ScreenGui
					Instance.new("UICorner", Frame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

					local UIStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")

					UIStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 55)
					UIStroke.Thickness = 1
					UIStroke.Parent = Frame

					local parent = Instance.new("Frame")

					parent.Name = "Header"
					parent.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22)
					parent.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
					parent.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 28)
					parent.BorderSizePixel = 0
					parent.Parent = Frame
					Instance.new("UICorner", parent).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

					local TextLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")

					TextLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 1, 0)
					TextLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 0)
					TextLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
					TextLabel.Text = "Cooldowns"
					TextLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
					TextLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
					TextLabel.TextSize = 11
					TextLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
					TextLabel.Parent = parent

					local list = Instance.new("Frame")

					list.Name = "List"
					list.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -22)
					list.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 22)
					list.BackgroundTransparency = 1
					list.Parent = Frame

					local UIListLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")

					UIListLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 2)
					UIListLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
					UIListLayout.Parent = list

					local UIPadding = Instance.new("UIPadding")

					UIPadding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 7)
					UIPadding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 5)
					UIPadding.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 4)
					UIPadding.Parent = list
					self._gui = ScreenGui
					self._frame = Frame
					self._list = list
				end,
				refresh = function(self)
					if not self._gui or not self._frame then
						return
					end
					local listDirty = durationsData._listDirty
					local selectedList = durationsData:getSelectedList()
					local sumNumber = #selectedList
					if sumNumber == 0 then
						self._frame.Visible = false

						return
					end
					if not listDirty and nextFunction(self._labels) == nil then
						listDirty = true
					end
					if listDirty then
						local next = nextFunction
						local labels = self._labels
						local flag
						while true do
							local instance

							flag, instance = next(labels, flag)

							if not flag then
								break
							end

							if instance and instance.Parent then
								instance:Destroy()
							end
						end
						self._labels = {}
						for layoutOrder, item in ipairsFunction(selectedList) do
							local TextLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")

							TextLabel.Name = "CD_" .. tostringFunction(layoutOrder)
							TextLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 15)
							TextLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
							TextLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
							TextLabel.TextSize = 11
							TextLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
							TextLabel.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
							TextLabel.LayoutOrder = layoutOrder
							TextLabel.Parent = self._list
							self._labels[item] = TextLabel
						end
						local sum = 28 + sumNumber * 17
						if sum < 30 then
							sum = 30
						end
						self._frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(192, sum)
					end
					local textColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 220, 80)
					local secondaryTextColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 70)
					local expiryTimes = durationsData.expiryTimes
					local durations = durationsData.durations
					local displayNames = durationsData.displayNames
					local expectedMembership = tickFunction()
					local next = nextFunction
					local labels = self._labels
					local textFlag
					while true do
						local parent

						textFlag, parent = next(labels, textFlag)

						if not textFlag then
							break
						end

						local secondaryParent = parent

						if parent then
							secondaryParent = parent.Parent
						end

						if secondaryParent then
							local text = displayNames[textFlag] or textFlag

							if
								(durations[textFlag] or 0) <= 0
								or expectedMembership >= (expiryTimes[textFlag] or 0)
							then
								parent.Text = text
								parent.TextColor3 = textColor3
							else
								local textNumber = math.ceil((expiryTimes[textFlag] or 0) - expectedMembership)

								parent.Text = text .. " (" .. tostringFunction(textNumber) .. "s)"
								parent.TextColor3 = secondaryTextColor
							end
						end
					end
					self._frame.Visible = self.Enabled
				end,
				show = function(self, enabled)
					self.Enabled = enabled

					if enabled then
						if not self._gui then
							self:build()
						end

						pcall(function()
							self:refresh()
						end)

						return
					end

					if self._frame then
						self._frame.Visible = false
					end
				end,
			}
			secondaryHandleInstanceProperties("CooldownWindow", function()
				if not hbFrameData.Enabled then
					return
				end

				hbFrameData._hbFrame = hbFrameData._hbFrame + 1

				if hbFrameData._hbFrame < 4 * lastTimeData.ThrottleFactor then
					return
				end

				hbFrameData._hbFrame = 0
				pcall(function()
					hbFrameData:refresh()
				end)
			end)
			frameData = {
				auraOn = false,
				noStunOn = false,
				noSlowedOn = false,
				auraHighlight = nil,
				auraParticles = {},
				auraColorTime = 0,
				_frame = 0,
				_auraFrame = 0,
				enableAura = function(self, adornee, tertiaryArgument)
					if self.auraHighlight then
						return
					end

					local _, _ = pcall(function()
						local Animation = Instance.new("Animation")

						Animation.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://114586157428274"

						local track = tertiaryArgument:LoadAnimation(Animation)

						track:Play()

						return track
					end)

					self.auraHighlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
					self.auraHighlight.Adornee = adornee
					self.auraHighlight.FillTransparency = 1
					self.auraHighlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
					self.auraHighlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 255)
					self.auraHighlight.Parent = adornee

					for _, item in ipairsFunction({
						"UpperTorso",
						"LowerTorso",
						"HumanoidRootPart",
					}) do
						local parent = adornee:FindFirstChild(item)

						if parent then
							local Attachment = Instance.new("Attachment", parent)
							local ParticleEmitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter", Attachment)

							ParticleEmitter.Name = "DarkAura"
							ParticleEmitter.Rate = 30
							ParticleEmitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(1.2, 2)
							ParticleEmitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(2, 5)
							ParticleEmitter.Size = NumberSequence.new({
								NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 3),
								NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
							})
							ParticleEmitter.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
								NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.1),
								NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
							})
							ParticleEmitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15))
							ParticleEmitter.Rotation = NumberRange.new(0, 360)
							ParticleEmitter.RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(-90, 90)
							ParticleEmitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180)
							ParticleEmitter.ZOffset = -1
							insert(self.auraParticles, ParticleEmitter)
						end
					end
				end,
			}
			additionalData = nil

			function frameData.disableAura(self)
				if self.auraHighlight then
					pcall(function()
						self.auraHighlight:Destroy()
					end)
					self.auraHighlight = nil
				end

				for _, item in ipairsFunction(self.auraParticles) do
					local capturedItem = item

					pcall(function()
						if capturedItem then
							capturedItem:Destroy()
						end
					end)
				end

				self.auraParticles = {}
				self.auraColorTime = 0
			end

			secondaryHandleInstanceProperties("LocalFeatures", function()
				frameData._frame = frameData._frame + 1

				if frameData._frame >= 3 * lastTimeData.ThrottleFactor then
					frameData._frame = 0

					if frameData.noStunOn or frameData.noSlowedOn then
						local Character = LocalPlayer.Character

						if Character then
							if frameData.noStunOn then
								local Stunned = Character:FindFirstChild("Stunned")

								if Stunned then
									pcall(function()
										Stunned:Destroy()
									end)
								end

								local Humanoid = Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")

								if Humanoid then
									if Humanoid.PlatformStand then
										Humanoid.PlatformStand = false
									end

									if Humanoid.WalkSpeed == 0 then
										Humanoid.WalkSpeed = 16
									end
								end
							end

							if frameData.noSlowedOn then
								local Humanoid = Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")

								if Humanoid then
									if Humanoid.WalkSpeed < 20 then
										Humanoid.WalkSpeed = 20
									end

									if Humanoid.PlatformStand then
										Humanoid.PlatformStand = false
									end
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end

				if frameData.auraOn and frameData.auraHighlight then
					frameData._auraFrame = frameData._auraFrame + 1

					if frameData._auraFrame >= 6 then
						frameData._auraFrame = 0
						frameData.auraColorTime = frameData.auraColorTime + 0.1

						local auraColorTime = frameData.auraColorTime
						local outlineColorNumber = floor(sin(auraColorTime) * 127 + 128)
						local number = floor(sin(auraColorTime + 2) * 127 + 128)
						local secondaryOutlineColorNumber = floor(sin(auraColorTime + 4) * 127 + 128)

						pcall(function()
							frameData.auraHighlight.OutlineColor =
								Color3.fromRGB(outlineColorNumber, number, secondaryOutlineColorNumber)
						end)
					end
				end
			end)
			capturedFlag = false
			alternateData = {}
			createNameEspData = nil
			createNameEspData = {}

			local function createNameEsp(headContainer)
				if headContainer == LocalPlayer.Character then
					return
				end

				if createNameEspData[headContainer] then
					return
				end

				local Head = headContainer:FindFirstChild("Head")

				if not Head then
					return
				end

				local BillboardGui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")

				BillboardGui.Name = "NameESP"
				BillboardGui.Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 20)
				BillboardGui.StudsOffset = new(0, 2.2, 0)
				BillboardGui.AlwaysOnTop = true
				BillboardGui.Adornee = Head
				BillboardGui.Parent = Head

				local TextLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")

				TextLabel.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
				TextLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				TextLabel.Text = headContainer.Name
				TextLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 255)
				TextLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.4
				TextLabel.TextScaled = true
				TextLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
				TextLabel.Parent = BillboardGui
				createNameEspData[headContainer] = BillboardGui
			end

			capturedTextLabel = nil

			function secondaryHandler()
				for _, item in ipairsFunction(Players:GetPlayers()) do
					if item.Character then
						createNameEsp(item.Character)
					end
				end

				insert(
					alternateData,
					Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
						insert(
							alternateData,
							player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
								task.wait(0.5)

								if capturedFlag then
									createNameEsp(character)
								end
							end)
						)
					end)
				)

				for _, item in ipairsFunction(Players:GetPlayers()) do
					if item ~= LocalPlayer then
						insert(
							alternateData,
							item.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
								task.wait(0.5)

								if capturedFlag then
									createNameEsp(character)
								end
							end)
						)
					end
				end
			end

			capturedScreenGui = nil

			function alternateHandler()
				local next = nextFunction
				local flag
				local data = createNameEspData
				while true do
					local flagResult

					flag, flagResult = next(data, flag)

					if not flag then
						break
					end

					local capturedFlagResult = flagResult

					pcall(function()
						if capturedFlagResult then
							capturedFlagResult:Destroy()
						end
					end)
				end
				for _, item in ipairsFunction(alternateData) do
					handlerVariantI(item)
				end
				alternateData = {}
			end

			createPurpleBoxData = nil
			capturedFlagCondition = false

			local outerData = {}
			local createPlayerHighlightData = {}

			createPlayerHighlight = nil

			function createPlayerHighlight(parent, player)
				if player == LocalPlayer then
					return
				end

				if createPlayerHighlightData[player] then
					return
				end

				local Highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")

				Highlight.Name = "PlayerHighlight"
				Highlight.Adornee = parent
				Highlight.FillTransparency = 1
				Highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
				Highlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
				Highlight.Parent = parent
				createPlayerHighlightData[player] = Highlight
			end
			function additionalHandler()
				for _, item in ipairsFunction(Players:GetPlayers()) do
					if item.Character then
						createPlayerHighlight(item.Character, item)
					end
				end

				insert(
					outerData,
					Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
						insert(
							outerData,
							player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
								task.wait(0.5)

								if capturedFlagCondition then
									createPlayerHighlight(character, player)
								end
							end)
						)
					end)
				)

				for _, item in ipairsFunction(Players:GetPlayers()) do
					local capturedItem = item

					if capturedItem ~= LocalPlayer then
						insert(
							outerData,
							capturedItem.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
								task.wait(0.5)

								if capturedFlagCondition then
									createPlayerHighlight(character, capturedItem)
								end
							end)
						)
					end
				end
			end
			function fallbackHandler()
				local flag
				local next = nextFunction
				local data = createPlayerHighlightData
				while true do
					local flagResult

					flag, flagResult = next(data, flag)

					if not flag then
						break
					end

					local capturedFlagResult = flagResult

					pcall(function()
						if capturedFlagResult then
							capturedFlagResult:Destroy()
						end
					end)
				end
				for _, item in ipairsFunction(outerData) do
					handlerVariantI(item)
				end
			end

			secondaryFlag = false
			createPurpleBoxData = {}
			additionalData = {}

			local function createPurpleBox(player)
				if player == LocalPlayer then
					return
				end

				if createPurpleBoxData[player] then
					return
				end

				if not player.Character then
					return
				end

				local HumanoidRootPart = player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

				if not HumanoidRootPart then
					return
				end

				local BoxHandleAdornment = Instance.new("BoxHandleAdornment")

				BoxHandleAdornment.Name = "PurpleBox"
				BoxHandleAdornment.Adornee = HumanoidRootPart
				BoxHandleAdornment.AlwaysOnTop = true
				BoxHandleAdornment.ZIndex = 5
				BoxHandleAdornment.Size = new(2, 2, 1)
				BoxHandleAdornment.Color3 = Color3.fromRGB(170, 0, 255)
				BoxHandleAdornment.Transparency = 0.3
				BoxHandleAdornment.Parent = HumanoidRootPart
				createPurpleBoxData[player] = BoxHandleAdornment
			end

			function nestedHandler()
				for _, item in ipairsFunction(Players:GetPlayers()) do
					if item.Character then
						createPurpleBox(item)
					end
				end

				insert(
					additionalData,
					Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
						local insertFunction = insert
						local secondaryData = additionalData
						local data = {
							player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(_)
								task.wait(0.5)

								if secondaryFlag then
									createPurpleBox(player)
								end
							end),
						}

						insertFunction(secondaryData, unpackValues(data))
					end)
				)

				for _, item in ipairsFunction(Players:GetPlayers()) do
					local capturedItem = item

					if capturedItem ~= LocalPlayer then
						insert(
							additionalData,
							capturedItem.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(_)
								task.wait(0.5)

								if secondaryFlag then
									createPurpleBox(capturedItem)
								end
							end)
						)
					end
				end
			end
			function innerHandler()
				local next = nextFunction
				local data = createPurpleBoxData
				local flag
				while true do
					local flagResult

					flag, flagResult = next(data, flag)

					if not flag then
						break
					end

					local capturedFlagResult = flagResult

					pcall(function()
						if capturedFlagResult then
							capturedFlagResult:Destroy()
						end
					end)
				end
				createPurpleBoxData = {}
				for _, item in ipairsFunction(additionalData) do
					handlerVariantI(item)
				end
				additionalData = {}
			end

			capturedScreenGui = nil
			capturedTextLabel = nil
			flag = false

			function createPlayerCountGui()
				if capturedScreenGui and capturedScreenGui.Parent then
					return
				end

				local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")

				ScreenGui.Name = "PlayerCountGui"
				ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
				ScreenGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
				ScreenGui.Parent = PlayerGui
				innerData:protectGUI(ScreenGui)

				local TextLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")

				TextLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 50)
				TextLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -110, 0, 50)
				TextLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				TextLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
				TextLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.2
				TextLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
				TextLabel.TextScaled = true
				TextLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
				TextLabel.TextTransparency = 1
				TextLabel.Text = "Players: " .. #Players:GetPlayers()
				TextLabel.Parent = ScreenGui
				TweenService:Create(TextLabel, TweenInfo.new(0.6, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
					TextTransparency = 0,
				}):Play()
				capturedScreenGui = ScreenGui
				capturedTextLabel = TextLabel
				flag = true
				task.spawn(function()
					while flag do
						task.wait(2)

						if capturedTextLabel and capturedTextLabel.Parent then
							capturedTextLabel.Text = "Players: " .. #Players:GetPlayers()
						end
					end
				end)
			end
			function outerHandler()
				flag = false

				if capturedScreenGui and capturedScreenGui.Parent then
					pcall(function()
						capturedScreenGui:Destroy()
					end)
				end

				if capturedTextLabel and capturedTextLabel.Parent then
					pcall(function()
						capturedTextLabel:Destroy()
					end)
				end

				capturedScreenGui = nil
				capturedTextLabel = nil
			end

			createHighlightData = nil
			folder = nil
