			local function createDynamicEsp()
				if not folder or not folder.Parent then
					folder = Instance.new("Folder")
					folder.Name = "DynamicESP"
					folder.Parent = Workspace
				end

				return folder
			end

			handleTextLabel = nil
			fallbackData = nil

			function handleTextLabel(player)
				local Backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")

				if Backpack then
					local next = nextFunction
					local textLabelFlag
					local textLabelData = capturedData
					local flagData
					repeat
						textLabelFlag, flagData = next(textLabelData, textLabelFlag)

						if not textLabelFlag then
							return "Tech Prodigy", Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
						end
					until Backpack:FindFirstChild(textLabelFlag)

					return flagData[1], flagData[2]
				end

				return "Tech Prodigy", Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
			end

			local function createName(player)
				if player == LocalPlayer then
					return
				end

				local Character = player.Character

				if not Character or not Character:FindFirstChild("Head") then
					return
				end

				local parent = createDynamicEsp()

				if parent:FindFirstChild(player.Name) then
					return
				end

				local textLabel, textLabelColor = handleTextLabel(player)
				local BillboardGui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")

				BillboardGui.Name = player.Name
				BillboardGui.Adornee = Character.Head
				BillboardGui.Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 20)
				BillboardGui.StudsOffset = new(3.5, 0.5, 0)
				BillboardGui.AlwaysOnTop = true
				BillboardGui.Parent = parent

				local TextLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel", BillboardGui)

				TextLabel.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
				TextLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				TextLabel.Text = textLabel
				TextLabel.TextColor3 = textLabelColor
				TextLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
				TextLabel.TextScaled = false
				TextLabel.TextSize = 12
				TextLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.6
				TextLabel.TextTransparency = 1
				TweenService:Create(TextLabel, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {
					TextTransparency = 0,
					TextStrokeTransparency = 0.3,
				}):Play()
			end

			nestedData = nil

			local function handlerVariantA()
				for _, item in ipairsFunction(createDynamicEsp():GetChildren()) do
					local capturedItem = item

					pcall(function()
						capturedItem:Destroy()
					end)
				end
			end

			handler = nil

			function handler()
				handlerVariantA()

				for _, item in ipairsFunction(Players:GetPlayers()) do
					createName(item)
				end
			end
			function previousHandler()
				handler()
				task.spawn(function()
					while alternateFlag do
						handler()
						task.wait(2)
					end
				end)
			end
			function currentHandler()
				handlerVariantA()
			end

			createHighlightData = {}
			nestedData = {}
			additionalFlag = false

			local function createHighlight(parent)
				if createHighlightData[parent] then
					return
				end

				local Highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")

				Highlight.Adornee = parent
				Highlight.FillTransparency = 1
				Highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
				Highlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(170, 0, 255)
				Highlight.Parent = parent
				createHighlightData[parent] = Highlight
			end

			function nextHandler()
				local Live = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Live")

				if not Live then
					return
				end

				for _, parent in ipairsFunction(Live:GetChildren()) do
					if parent:IsA("Model") and parent.Name == "Weakest Dummy" then
						createHighlight(parent)
					end
				end

				insert(
					nestedData,
					Live.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
						if child:IsA("Model") and child.Name == "Weakest Dummy" then
							task.wait(0.2)
							createHighlight(child)
						end
					end)
				)
			end
			function sourceHandler()
				local flag
				local next = nextFunction
				local data = createHighlightData
				while true do
					local flagResult

					flag, flagResult = next(data, flag)

					if not flag then
						break
					end

					local capturedFlagResult = flagResult

					pcall(function()
						if capturedFlagResult then
							capturedFlagResult:Destroy()
						end
					end)
				end
				createHighlightData = {}
				for _, item in ipairsFunction(nestedData) do
					handlerVariantI(item)
				end
				nestedData = {}
			end

			createNameTagData = {}
			fallbackData = {}
			fallbackFlag = false

			local function createNameTag(parent)
				if createNameTagData[parent] then
					return
				end

				local HumanoidRootPart = parent:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

				if not HumanoidRootPart then
					return
				end

				local BillboardGui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")

				BillboardGui.Name = "NameTag"
				BillboardGui.Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 25)
				BillboardGui.Adornee = HumanoidRootPart
				BillboardGui.AlwaysOnTop = true
				BillboardGui.StudsOffset = new(0, 3.5, 0)
				BillboardGui.Parent = parent

				local TextLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")

				TextLabel.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
				TextLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				TextLabel.Text = parent.Name
				TextLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 0)
				TextLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.2
				TextLabel.TextScaled = true
				TextLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
				TextLabel.Parent = BillboardGui
				createNameTagData[parent] = BillboardGui
			end

			function targetHandler()
				local Live = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Live")

				if not Live then
					return
				end

				local GetChildren = Live.GetChildren

				for _, parent in ipairsFunction(GetChildren(Live)) do
					if parent:IsA("Model") and parent.Name == "Weakest Dummy" then
						createNameTag(parent)
					end
				end

				insert(
					fallbackData,
					Live.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
						if child:IsA("Model") and child.Name == "Weakest Dummy" then
							task.wait(0.2)
							createNameTag(child)
						end
					end)
				)
			end
		end

		function handlerVariantA()
			local flag
			local next = nextFunction
			local data = createNameTagData
			while true do
				local flagResult

				flag, flagResult = next(data, flag)

				if not flag then
					break
				end

				local capturedFlagResult = flagResult

				pcall(function()
					if capturedFlagResult then
						capturedFlagResult:Destroy()
					end
				end)
			end
			createNameTagData = {}
			for _, item in ipairsFunction(fallbackData) do
				handlerVariantI(item)
			end
			fallbackData = {}
		end

		local function handleHumanoidRootPartContainer()
			tickFunction()
			local Live = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Live")
			if not Live then
				return nil
			end
			local Character = LocalPlayer.Character
			local input = Character and Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not input then
				return nil
			end
			local Position = input.Position
			local magnitudeNumber = distNumber
			local humanoidRootPartContainer
			for _, secondaryHumanoidRootPartContainer in ipairsFunction(Live:GetChildren()) do
				if
					secondaryHumanoidRootPartContainer:IsA("Model")
					and secondaryHumanoidRootPartContainer.Name == "Weakest Dummy"
				then
					local HumanoidRootPart = secondaryHumanoidRootPartContainer:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

					if HumanoidRootPart then
						local difference = HumanoidRootPart.Position.X - Position.X
						local number = HumanoidRootPart.Position.Z - Position.Z
						local sum = difference * difference + number * number

						if sum < magnitudeNumber then
							magnitudeNumber = sum
							humanoidRootPartContainer = secondaryHumanoidRootPartContainer
						end
					end
				end
			end

			return humanoidRootPartContainer
		end

		handlerVariantH("OrbitDummy", function(_) end)

		function handlerVariantB(tab, name, tertiaryArgument, valueData, additionalArgument, secondaryFlag)
			local currentValue = tostringFunction(tertiaryArgument)

			tab:CreateInput({
				Name = name,
				CurrentValue = currentValue,
				PlaceholderText = "",
				RemoveTextAfterFocusLost = false,
				Callback = function(argument)
					local flag = tonumberFunction(argument)

					if flag and not secondaryFlag or flag > 0 then
						valueData[additionalArgument] = flag
						data:saveConfig()
					end
				end,
			})
		end
		function handlerVariantC() end
		function handlerVariantD() end
		function updateCFrame(updateCFrameCondition)
			local Character = LocalPlayer.Character

			if not Character then
				return
			end

			local HumanoidRootPart = Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

			if not HumanoidRootPart then
				return
			end

			local humanoidRootPartContainer = handleHumanoidRootPartContainer()

			if not humanoidRootPartContainer then
				return
			end

			local humanoidRootPart = humanoidRootPartContainer:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

			if not humanoidRootPart then
				return
			end

			local position = humanoidRootPart.Position
			local secondaryNew = new(position.X, HumanoidRootPart.Position.Y, position.Z)
			local cFrame = cFrameCallback(secondaryNew) * (HumanoidRootPart.CFrame - HumanoidRootPart.Position)

			if updateCFrameCondition then
				TweenService:Create(HumanoidRootPart, TweenInfo.new(0.6, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine), {
					CFrame = cFrame,
				}):Play()

				return
			end

			HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = cFrame
		end
		function handlerVariantE(tab, name, updateInstancePropertiesData, text, secondaryFlag)
			local currentValue = not not updateInstancePropertiesData.Active
				and (updateInstancePropertiesData.Active[text] or false)
			local flag = secondaryFlag or text .. "_Toggle"

			tab:CreateToggle({
				Name = name,
				CurrentValue = currentValue,
				Flag = flag,
				Callback = function(argument)
					if updateInstancePropertiesData.Active then
						updateInstancePropertiesData.Active[text] = argument
					end

					durationsData:setSelected(text, argument)

					if hbFrameData.Enabled then
						pcall(function()
							hbFrameData:refresh()
						end)
					end

					data:saveConfig()
				end,
			})
		end
		function handlerVariantF(tab, name, tertiaryArgument)
			tab:CreateInput({
				Name = name,
				CurrentValue = "0",
				PlaceholderText = "Ej: 5 o 2.5",
				RemoveTextAfterFocusLost = false,
				Callback = function(argument)
					local flag = tonumberFunction(argument)

					if flag and flag >= 0 then
						for _, item in ipairsFunction(tertiaryArgument) do
							durationsData:setDuration(item, flag)
						end

						data:saveConfig()
					end
				end,
			})
		end

		"GarouLethalFlowing",
		"GAR_LF",

		isTabValidData("ComboGarouM1HG"),
		"GarouM1HunterGrasp",
		"GAR_M1HG",
	}

	garouHunterPushData = {}

	local flagData = {
		GarouM4Lethal = "GarouM4Flowing",
		GarouM4Flowing = "GarouM4Lethal",
	}
	local dataVariantF = {
		GarouHunterPush = true,
		GarouHunterTeleport = true,
	}

	for _, item in ipairsFunction({
		outerData,
		previousData,
		currentData,
		nextData,
		sourceData,
		targetData,
		dataVariantA,
		dataVariantB,
		dataVariantC,
		dataVariantD,
		dataVariantE,
	}) do
		local result = item[2]
		local name = item[1]
		local currentValue = activeData.Active[result]
		local flag = item[3]

		garouHunterPushData[result] = fallbackTab:CreateToggle({
			Name = name,
			CurrentValue = currentValue,
			Flag = flag,
			Callback = function(flag)
				activeData.Active[result] = flag

				local condition = flag
				local conditionFlag = flagData[result]

				if flag then
					condition = conditionFlag and activeData.Active[conditionFlag]
				end

				if condition then
					activeData.Active[conditionFlag] = false

					if garouHunterPushData[conditionFlag] then
						garouHunterPushData[conditionFlag]:Set(false)
					end
				end

				if flag and (dataVariantF[result] and activeData.Active.NinjaM1UpShuriken) then
					activeData.Active.NinjaM1UpShuriken = false

					if innerData and innerData.NinjaM1UpShuriken then
						innerData.NinjaM1UpShuriken:Set(false)
					end

					durationsData:setSelected("NinjaM1UpShuriken", false)
				end

				durationsData:setSelected(result, flag)

				if hbFrameData.Enabled then
					pcall(function()
						hbFrameData:refresh()
					end)
				end

				data:saveConfig()
			end,
		})
	end

	fallbackTab:CreateSection("Tiempo de Recarga")
	handlerVariantF(fallbackTab, isTabValidData("CDGarou"), {
		"GarouHunterPush",
		"GarouHunterTeleport",
		"GarouFlowingDash",
		"GarouFlowingHunter",
		"GarouM4Lethal",
		"GarouM4Flowing",
		"GarouInstaTwintsFollow",
		"GarouInstaTwints",
		"GarouKyoto",
		"GarouLethalFlowing",
		"GarouM1HunterGrasp",
	})
end

	},
}) do

			currentValueData.Active[capturedItem[2]] = active
			durationsData:setSelected(capturedItem[2], active)

			if hbFrameData.Enabled then
				pcall(function()
					hbFrameData:refresh()
				end)
			end

			data:saveConfig()
		end,
	})
end

local previousData = {}
local flagData = {
	TechKingM1Up = "TechSupaM1Up",
	TechSupaM1Up = "TechKingM1Up",
}
for _, item in ipairsFunction(outerData) do
	local result, name, createToggle, currentValue

	do
		result = item[2]
		name = item[1]

		local t51Active = activeData.Active

		createToggle = fallbackTab.CreateToggle
		currentValue = t51Active[result]
	end

	local flag = item[3]

	previousData[result] = createToggle(fallbackTab, {
		Name = name,
		CurrentValue = currentValue,
		Flag = flag,
		Callback = function(condition)
			activeData.Active[result] = condition

			local conditionFlag = flagData[result]

			if condition then
				condition = conditionFlag and activeData.Active[conditionFlag]
			end

			if condition then
				activeData.Active[conditionFlag] = false

				if previousData[conditionFlag] then
					previousData[conditionFlag]:Set(false)
				end
			end

			data:saveConfig()
		end,
	})
end

enemyData:initialize()
secondaryData:create()
if LocalPlayer.Character then
	task.spawn(function()
		local Character = LocalPlayer.Character
		local capturedCharacter = Character
		pcall(function()
			activeData:setupCharacter(capturedCharacter)
		end)
		pcall(function()
			currentValueData:setupCharacter(capturedCharacter)
		end)
		pcall(function()
			secondaryUpdateInstancePropertiesData:setupCharacter(capturedCharacter)
		end)
		pcall(function()
			alternateUpdateInstancePropertiesData:setupCharacter(capturedCharacter)
		end)
	end)
end
task.spawn(function()
	task.wait(1)

	local configData = data.configData

	if not configData or not nextFunction(configData) then
		return
	end

	local function isEnabledValid(isEnabledValidResult, secondaryArgument)
		if isEnabledValidResult == nil then
			return secondaryArgument
		end

		return isEnabledValidResult == true
	end
	local function isPropensionValid(isPropensionValidArgument, flag)
		local isPropensionValidFlag = tonumberFunction(isPropensionValidArgument)

		return isPropensionValidFlag ~= nil and isPropensionValidFlag or flag
	end

	if configData.DashAssistV3 then
		local enabledResult = configData.DashAssistV3

		sumData.ENABLED = isEnabledValid(enabledResult.enabled, false)
		sumData.ASSIST_ENABLED = isEnabledValid(enabledResult.assistEnabled, false)
		sumData.DETECTION_RADIUS = isPropensionValid(enabledResult.detectionRadius, 50)
		sumData.SMOOTHING_ENABLED = isEnabledValid(enabledResult.smoothingEnabled, false)
		sumData.SMOOTHING_LEVEL = isPropensionValid(enabledResult.smoothingLevel, 5)
		sumData.PREDICTION_ENABLED = isEnabledValid(enabledResult.predictionEnabled, false)
		sumData.PREDICTION_LEVEL = isPropensionValid(enabledResult.predictionLevel, 7)
		sumData.SPEED_ENABLED = isEnabledValid(enabledResult.speedEnabled, false)
		sumData.SPEED_LEVEL = isPropensionValid(enabledResult.speedLevel, 5)

		if sumData.PREDICTION_ENABLED then
			createDashAssistPredPos()
		end
	end

	if configData.HCDAssist then
		local hcdAssist = configData.HCDAssist

		porCamaraData.RADIO_DETECCION = isPropensionValid(hcdAssist.radioDeteccion, 35)
		porCamaraData.FACTOR_PREDICCION = isPropensionValid(hcdAssist.factorPrediccion, 8)
		porCamaraData.INTENSIDAD_GIRO = isPropensionValid(hcdAssist.intensidadGiro, 8)
		porCamaraData.ORBITA_ACTIVADA = isEnabledValid(hcdAssist.orbitaActivada, false)
		porCamaraData.PROPENSION_ORBITA = isPropensionValid(hcdAssist.propensionOrbita, 5)
		porCamaraData.POR_CAMARA = isEnabledValid(hcdAssist.porCamara, false)
		porCamaraData.EMPUJE_ACTIVADO = isEnabledValid(hcdAssist.empujeActivado, false)
		porCamaraData.NIVEL_EMPUJE = isPropensionValid(hcdAssist.nivelEmpuje, 5)
		porCamaraData.CONSTANTE_ACTIVADO = isEnabledValid(hcdAssist.constanteActivado, false)
		porCamaraData.NIVEL_CONSTANTE = isPropensionValid(hcdAssist.nivelConstante, 5)

		if isEnabledValid(hcdAssist.enabled, false) then
			porCamaraData:start()
		end
	end

	if configData.Camlock then
		local camlock = configData.Camlock

		enemyData.Config.AimbotSpeed = isPropensionValid(camlock.speed, 5)
		enemyData.Config.PredictionEnabled = isEnabledValid(camlock.prediction, false)
		enemyData.Config.CameraEnabled = isEnabledValid(camlock.stopInRange, false)
		enemyData.Config.CameraRange = isPropensionValid(camlock.range, 5)
	end

	if configData.DashVisualizer and isEnabledValid(configData.DashVisualizer.enabled, false) then
		updateInstancePropertiesData.Enabled = true
		updateInstancePropertiesData.Separation = isPropensionValid(configData.DashVisualizer.separation, 8)
		updateInstancePropertiesData:updateSeparation()
		task.spawn(function()
			updateInstancePropertiesData:initialize()
		end)
	end

	if configData.DashReverse and isEnabledValid(configData.DashReverse.enabled, false) then
		pcall(function()
			additionalUpdateInstancePropertiesData:start()
		end)
	end

	if configData.Combos then
		local next = nextFunction
		local combos = configData.Combos
		local flag
		while true do
			local flagResult

			flag, flagResult = next(combos, flag)

			if not flag then
				break
			end

			if type(flag) == "string" then
				activeData.Active[flag] = isEnabledValid(flagResult, false)
			end
		end
	end

	if configData.GarouMonster then
		local next = nextFunction
		local garouMonster = configData.GarouMonster
		local flag
		while true do
			local flagResult

			flag, flagResult = next(garouMonster, flag)

			if not flag then
				break
			end

			if type(flag) == "string" then
				currentValueData.Active[flag] = isEnabledValid(flagResult, false)
			end
		end
	end

	if configData.Tatsumaki then
		local next = nextFunction
		local tatsumaki = configData.Tatsumaki
		local flag
		while true do
			local flagResult

			flag, flagResult = next(tatsumaki, flag)

			if not flag then
				break
			end

			if type(flag) == "string" then
				secondaryUpdateInstancePropertiesData.Active[flag] = isEnabledValid(flagResult, false)
			end
		end
	end

	if configData.Cyborg then
		local next = nextFunction
		local cyborg = configData.Cyborg
		local flag
		while true do
			local flagResult

			flag, flagResult = next(cyborg, flag)

			if not flag then
				break
			end

			if type(flag) == "string" then
				alternateUpdateInstancePropertiesData.Active[flag] = isEnabledValid(flagResult, false)
			end
		end
	end

	if configData.CooldownDurations then
		local next = nextFunction
		local CooldownDurations = configData.CooldownDurations
		local flag
		while true do
			local flagResult

			flag, flagResult = next(CooldownDurations, flag)

			if not flag then
				break
			end

			local result = tonumberFunction(flagResult)

			if result and result >= 0 then
				durationsData:setDuration(flag, result)
			end
		end
	end

	if configData.ESPCounter then
		local espCounter = configData.ESPCounter

		cfgData.EnabledCounter = isEnabledValid(espCounter.enabledCounter, false)
		cfgData.EnabledUltimate = isEnabledValid(espCounter.enabledUltimate, false)

		if espCounter.detectionRange ~= nil then
			local detectionRange = isPropensionValid(espCounter.detectionRange, 30)

			cfgData.CFG.DETECTION_RANGE = detectionRange
			cfgData.CFG.RANGE_SQ = detectionRange * detectionRange
		end

		if espCounter.ultimateRange ~= nil then
			local ultimateRange = isPropensionValid(espCounter.ultimateRange, 30)

			cfgData.CFG.ULTIMATE_RANGE = ultimateRange
			cfgData.CFG.ULTIMATE_RANGE_SQ = ultimateRange * ultimateRange
		end

		if cfgData.EnabledCounter or cfgData.EnabledUltimate then
			cfgData:start()

			if cfgData.EnabledCounter then
				task.spawn(function()
					cfgData:_startLiveMonitor()
				end)
			end
		end
	end

	if configData.BlockRotateAssist then
		local blockRotateAssist = configData.BlockRotateAssist

		valueData.DETECTION_RANGE = isPropensionValid(blockRotateAssist.detectionRange, 30)
		valueData.PREDICTION_SCALE = isPropensionValid(blockRotateAssist.predictionScale, 0.03)

		if isEnabledValid(blockRotateAssist.enabled, false) then
			valueData:start()
		end
	end

	if configData.JumpBlock then
		local jumpBlock = configData.JumpBlock

		animConnData.PROPENSION = isPropensionValid(jumpBlock.propension, 5)
		animConnData.DETECTION_RADIUS = isPropensionValid(jumpBlock.detectionRadius, 35)

		if isEnabledValid(jumpBlock.enabled, false) then
			pcall(function()
				animConnData:start()
			end)
		end
	end

	if configData.ESPHit and isEnabledValid(configData.ESPHit.enabled, false) then
		pcall(function()
			fallbackUpdateInstancePropertiesData:start()
		end)
	end

	if configData.ESP then
		local ESP = configData.ESP

		if isEnabledValid(ESP.name, false) then
			pcall(secondaryHandler)
		end

		if isEnabledValid(ESP.highlight, false) then
			pcall(additionalHandler)
		end

		if isEnabledValid(ESP.box, false) then
			pcall(nestedHandler)
		end

		if isEnabledValid(ESP.espChar, false) then
			pcall(previousHandler)
		end
	end

	if configData.Monitor and isEnabledValid(configData.Monitor.enabled, false) then
		enabledData:toggle(true)
	end

	if configData.LocalFeatures then
		local localValueFeatures = configData.LocalFeatures

		frameData.noStunOn = isEnabledValid(localValueFeatures.noStun, false)
		frameData.noSlowedOn = isEnabledValid(localValueFeatures.noSlowed, false)

		if isEnabledValid(localValueFeatures.aura, false) then
			frameData.auraOn = true
			pcall(function()
				local Character = LocalPlayer.Character
				local option = Character and Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

				if Character and option then
					frameData:enableAura(Character, option)
				end
			end)
		end
	end

	if configData.CooldownWindow and isEnabledValid(configData.CooldownWindow.enabled, false) then
		pcall(function()
			hbFrameData:show(true)
		end)
	end

	pcall(function()
		local next = nextFunction
		local t51Active = activeData.Active
		local flag
		while true do
			local flagResult

			flag, flagResult = next(t51Active, flag)

			if not flag then
				break
			end

			durationsData:setSelected(flag, flagResult)
		end
		local secondaryNextFunction = nextFunction
		local t58Active = currentValueData.Active
		local result
		while true do
			local flagResult

			result, flagResult = secondaryNextFunction(t58Active, result)

			if not result then
				break
			end

			durationsData:setSelected(result, flagResult)
		end
		local alternateNextFunction = nextFunction
		local t60Active = secondaryUpdateInstancePropertiesData.Active
		local secondaryFlag
		while true do
			local flagResult

			secondaryFlag, flagResult = alternateNextFunction(t60Active, secondaryFlag)

			if not secondaryFlag then
				break
			end

			durationsData:setSelected(secondaryFlag, flagResult)
		end
		local additionalNextFunction = nextFunction
		local t61Active = alternateUpdateInstancePropertiesData.Active
		local alternateFlag
		while true do
			local flagResult

			alternateFlag, flagResult = additionalNextFunction(t61Active, alternateFlag)

			if not alternateFlag then
				break
			end

			durationsData:setSelected(alternateFlag, flagResult)
		end
	end)
	print("✅ Configuracion aplicada correctamente desde " .. data:getSavePath())
end)
showData:show(
	"✅ Sistema Unificado TSB",
	"Versión 3.6.4 — FrontDash Speed via dodgevelocity + decay ⚡",
	4,
	"success"
)
StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {
	Title = "🌟 TSB Unificado v3.6.4",
	Text = "by AlanbeikersFF — FrontDash Speed suma decay real al juego ✅",
	Duration = 4,
})
print("✅ Sistema Unificado TSB v3.6.4 cargado")
if tValue then
	tValue:initialize()

	if sumData.PREDICTION_ENABLED then
		createDashAssistPredPos()
	end

	print("✅ Dash Assist V3.3 inicializado")
else
	warn("⚠\239\184\143 DashAssistInstance no disponible — Módulo 15 no cargó correctamente")
end
pcall(function()
	local next = nextFunction
	local t51Active = activeData.Active
	local flag
	while true do
		local flagResult

		flag, flagResult = next(t51Active, flag)

		if not flag then
			break
		end

		durationsData:setSelected(flag, flagResult)
	end
	local secondaryNextFunction = nextFunction
	local t58Active = currentValueData.Active
	local result
	while true do
		local flagResult

		result, flagResult = secondaryNextFunction(t58Active, result)

		if not result then
			break
		end

		durationsData:setSelected(result, flagResult)
	end
	local alternateNextFunction = nextFunction
	local t60Active = secondaryUpdateInstancePropertiesData.Active
	local secondaryFlag
	while true do
		local flagResult

		secondaryFlag, flagResult = alternateNextFunction(t60Active, secondaryFlag)

		if not secondaryFlag then
			break
		end

		durationsData:setSelected(secondaryFlag, flagResult)
	end
	local additionalNextFunction = nextFunction
	local t61Active = alternateUpdateInstancePropertiesData.Active
	local alternateFlag
	while true do
		local flagResult

		alternateFlag, flagResult = additionalNextFunction(t61Active, alternateFlag)

		if not alternateFlag then
			break
		end

		durationsData:setSelected(alternateFlag, flagResult)
	end
end)

	pcall(function()
		rayfield:LoadConfiguration()
	end)
end)
